一、mcp接口
输入参数和返回结果的格式参考下面的文档
https://open.sellersprite.com/api/10

【平台通用约定】
- 响应包裹：统一 {code, message, data}，失败时 data 含 hint 处理建议
- returnFields（可选）：按需返回字段，取值为 data.items 元素（或 data）的字段名，分页信息始终保留
- 错误码表：OK / BAD_REQUEST / UPSTREAM_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR，及 JSON-RPC 协议错误（-32602 等）
详见同目录《通用约定.md》。

二、第三方curl请求及响应如下

            let url = $(middlePanelItem).find('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-middle-list-li-text').attr('href')
            // 设置左侧收藏跳转链接
            $(item).find('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-middle-list-li-text').attr('href', url)
            // 优麦云
            if(id == 'S2'){
                $(item).find('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-middle-list-li-text').attr('href', 'https://www.sellerspace.com')
            }
        })
    } else {
        $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').hide()
        $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list-for-empty').show()

        // 用户第一次操作，提示添加到收藏夹
        if(!window.localStorage.getItem('isNotFirstClickFavorite')){
            $('.iconForHover').each(function(idx, item){
                $(item).attr('data-original-title','点击添加到收藏夹')
                $(item).attr('data-toggle','tooltip')
            })
            window.localStorage.setItem('isNotFirstClickFavorite', true)
        }
    }
})

// 中间面板，点击收藏/取消收藏
$('.iconForClick').click(
    function(){
        let id = $(this).parent().attr('id')
        let favList = $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').children()
        let hasItem = false
        if(favList.length > 0){
            for(let i = 0; i < favList.length; i++){
                let itemId = $(favList[i]).attr('id')
                if(id == itemId){
                    hasItem = true
                }
            }
        }
        isAfterClick = true
        if(hasItem){
            $(this).removeClass('icon-gongnengshoucang').addClass('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang')
            cancelFavorites(id)
        }else{
            let target = $(this)
            addNewFavorite(target, id)
        }
        
    }
)
function addNewFavorite(target, id){
    target.removeClass('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang').addClass('icon-gongnengshoucang')
    let text = target.siblings().prop("firstChild").nodeValue;
    let link = target.siblings().attr('href')
    removeFavTooltip()
    addFavorites(text, link, id)
}

// 左侧已收藏行为，点击后取消收藏
$('.iconForLeftClick').click(
    function(){
        let id = $(this).parent().attr('id')
        cancelFavorites(id)
    }
)
function removeFavTooltip(){
    // 用户已经操作过，不再提示添加到收藏夹
    $('.iconForHover').each(function(idx, item){
        $(item).removeAttr('data-original-title')
        $(item).removeAttr('data-toggle')
    })
}

// 收藏接口
function addFavorites(text, link, id){
    let that = this;
    let ids = [id] ||[];
    $.ajax({
        type: 'post',
        url: '/v2/welcome/favorite',
        data: { key: ids.join(",") },
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (result) {
            that.addElToFavoriteList(text, link, id)
        },
        error: function (error) {
            alert('收藏失败')
        }
    });
}
// 删除收藏接口
function cancelFavorites(id){
    let that = this;
    let ids = [id] || []
    $.ajax({
        type: 'post',
        url: '/v2/welcome/favorites/delete/'+ ids.join(","),
        data: {},
        dataType: "json",
        success: function (result) {
            that.deleteElToFavoriteList(id)
        },
        error: function (error) {
            alert('取消收藏失败')
        }
    });
}

function addElToFavoriteList(text, link, id){
    // 左侧面板
    let elIcon = $('<i class="iconfont icon-gongnengshoucang iconForClick iconForHover" style="margin-right: 4px;"></i>')
    $(elIcon).on('click',function(){
        deleteElToFavoriteList(id)
    })
    $(elIcon).on('mouseenter',function(){
        changeIcon($(this))
    })
    $(elIcon).on('mouseleave', function(){
        changeIcon($(this))
    })
    let elLink = $('<a class="ss-v2-product-sub-menu-middle-list-li-text" style="margin-left: 4px;" ></a>').attr('href', link).text(text)
    let elLi = $('<li class="ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-li">').attr('id', id).append(elIcon, elLink)
    $(elLi).on('mouseenter',function(){
        $(this).children(":first").css('color','#FFB552')
    })
    $(elLi).on('mouseleave', function(){
        $(this).children(":first").css('color','transparent')
    })
    $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').append(elLi);
    if($('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').css('display') == 'none'){
        $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').show()
        $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list-for-empty').hide()
    }
    //导航栏 hover 收藏夹
    let navElLink = $('<a class="favorite-link" style="color: #595D68; padding: 10px 0; display: inline-block; font-size: 15px;" ></a>').attr('href', link).text(text)
    $(navElLink).on('mouseover',function(){
        $(this).css('color','#FB8C1E')
    })
    $(navElLink).on('mouseout', function(){
        $(this).css('color','#595D68')
    })
    let navElLi = $('<li></li>').attr('id', id).append(navElLink)
    $('.favorite-link-list').append(navElLi);
    $('#favListTrigger').show()
}
function deleteElToFavoriteList(id){
    // 左侧面板
    $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').find('#' + id).remove()
    $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-middle').find('#' + id).find('.icon-gongnengshoucang').removeClass('icon-gongnengshoucang').addClass('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang')
    if($('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').children().length == 0){
        $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list').hide()
        $('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu-left-list-for-empty').show()
    }

    //导航栏 hover 收藏夹
    $('.favorite-link-list').find('#' + id).remove()
    if($('.favorite-link-list').children().length == 0){
        $('#favListTrigger').hide()
    }
}

$('.iconForHover').on('mouseenter', function(){
    changeIcon($(this))
})

$('.iconForHover').on('mouseleave', function(){
    changeIcon($(this))
})

function changeIcon(target){
    if(!isAfterClick){
        let classList = target.attr('class').split(/\s+/);
        if(classList.includes('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang')){
            target.removeClass('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang').addClass('icon-gongnengshoucang')
        }
        if(classList.includes('icon-gongnengshoucang')){
        target.removeClass('icon-gongnengshoucang').addClass('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang')
        }
    } else {
        // 鼠标先触发 click 事件，再触发 mouseleave，收藏的图标不需要再次切换样式
        isAfterClick = false
    }
}

</script>

</style><script id="ssMsgListItem" type="text/template">
    {{each(i,m) msgList}}
    <li class="ss-msg-list-li" >
        <a class="ss-msg-list-li-left" href="{{= m.url}}" target="_self">
            <div class="ss-msg-list-li-title" >
                <span>${m.title}</span>
                <span>${tmpl_format.dateFormat(m.timestamp,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')}</span>
            </div>
            <p class="ss-msg-list-li-content" >
                ${m.repliedContent && m.repliedContent.length > 60 ? m.repliedContent.substring(0,60) + "..." :  m.repliedContent}
            </p>
        </a>
        <div class="ss-msg-list-li-right">
            <i onclick="markOneMsgRead(this)"  class="iconfont icon-gou" data-id="{{= m.messageId}}" ></i>
        </div>
    </li>
    {{/each}}
    <div class="ss-msg-list-all"><a href="/v2/message" target="_self">查看所有消息</a><div>
</script>
<script id="ssNoticeItem" type="text/template">
    {{each(i,m) noticeList}}
    <li class="ss-msg-list-li" >
        <a class="ss-msg-list-li-left" href="{{= m.url}}" target="_self">
            <div class="ss-msg-list-li-title" >
                {{if m.senderOfficial }}
                <span class="name">
                    <em class="guan-sellerSprite">官</em>
                    卖家精灵 ${m.action == 'U' ? '赞' :'回复'}了你的${m.messageType == 'Q' ? '反馈' :'评论'}
                </span>
                {{else}}
                <span>
                    {{if m.senderAvatar }}
                    <img class="ss-msg-list-li-img" src="{{= m.senderAvatar}}"/>
                    {{else}}
                    <img class="ss-msg-list-li-img" src="/assets/images/qa/community-avatar.png"/>
                    {{/if}}
                    ${m.senderNickname} ${m.action == 'U' ? '赞' :'回复'}了你的${m.messageType == 'Q' ? '反馈' :'评论'}
                </span>
                {{/if}}
                <span>${tmpl_format.dateFormat(m.timestamp,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')}</span>
            </div>
            <p class="ss-msg-list-li-content" >
                ${m.repliedContent && m.repliedContent.length > 60 ? m.repliedContent.substring(0,60) + "..." :  m.repliedContent}
            </p>
        </a>
        <div class="ss-msg-list-li-right">
            <i onclick="markOneNoticeRead(this)"  class="iconfont icon-gou" data-id="{{= m.messageId}}" data-type="{{= m.type}}"></i>
        </div>
    </li>
    {{/each}}
    </script>

<script>
$(function(){
    let sortableEl = document.getElementById('sortable')
    Sortable.create(sortableEl, { 
                        animation: 150,			
                        onEnd: function() {
                            let els = sortableEl.children
                            let keys = []
                            $(els).each(function(idx, item){
                                let id  = $(item).attr('id')
                                keys.push(id)
                            })
                            $.ajax({
                                type: 'post',
                                url: '/v2/welcome/favorites',
                                data: {keys: keys.join(",")},
                                dataType: "json",
                            });
                        }
                    });
});
    /**
    * 火狐浏览器在文字拖动时会打开链接，这是火狐浏览器的特性。
    * Sortable 拖动时需要禁用这个特性。
    */
    document.body.ondrop = function(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    };
</script>
<script>
    $(document).ready(function() {
        function updateMenuPadding() {
            const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
            let paddingRight;
            $("#nav-events").show()
            $("#nav-communities").show()
            $("#nav-live-streaming").show()
            $("#nav-more").hide()
            if (windowWidth>=1024 && windowWidth<=1200){
                if (windowWidth == 1024) {
                    paddingRight = 7; // 小于1024px时固定30px
                } else if (windowWidth == 1200) {
                    paddingRight = 20; // 大于1300px时固定25px
                } else {
                    // 在1024px~1300px区间线性递减
                    const progress = (windowWidth - 1024) / (1200 - 1024);
                    paddingRight = 7 + (13 * progress); // 30px递减到12px
                }

            }
            if (windowWidth>=768 && windowWidth<=1023){

                if (windowWidth == 768) {
                    paddingRight = 4; // 小于1024px时固定30px
                } else if (windowWidth == 1203) {
                    paddingRight = 7; // 大于1300px时固定25px
                } else {

                    // 在1024px~1300px区间线性递减
                    const progress = (windowWidth - 768) / (1023 - 768);
                    paddingRight = 4 + (3 * progress); //25px递减到18px
                    if(windowWidth < 992 && paddingRight > 5.5){
                        paddingRight = 5.5
                    }
                }
                $("#nav-events").hide()
                $("#nav-communities").hide()
                $("#nav-live-streaming").hide()
                $("#nav-more").show()
            }

            if (windowWidth >= 1366) {
                $('.mcp-service').show()
            } else {
                $('.mcp-service').hide()
            }

            $('#header-menu .nav-item').each(function() {
                var $li = $(this);
                if($li[0].classList[1] === 'ss-nav-login') return
                var $aTags = $li.children('a');
                var $otherChildren = $li.children().not('a');
                $li.each(function() {
                    this.style.setProperty('margin-right',  '0px', 'important');
                });
                if ($li.children().length === 1 && $aTags.length === 1) {
                    // 只有 a 标签
                    $aTags.css('padding-right', paddingRight + 'px');
                } else if ($otherChildren.length > 0) {
                    // 有其他标签
                    $otherChildren.css('padding-right', paddingRight + 'px');
                }
            });

        }

        // 初始化执行
        updateMenuPadding();

        // 监听resize事件，使用防抖优化性能
        let resizeTimer;
        $(window).on('resize', function() {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            resizeTimer = setTimeout(updateMenuPadding, 100);
        });
    });

function markAllMsgRead(ids){
    $.ajax({
        type: 'GET',
        url: '/v2/message/read',
        dataType: 'json',
        data: {
            'ids': ids
        },
        success: function (result) {
            handleRemoveLocalStorage()
            setTimeout(() => {
                getNoReadList()
            }, 200);
        },
    });
}

function markAllNoticeRead() {
    let noticeIds = []
    noticeList.forEach(function(item){
        if(item.type == 4 || item.type == 5){
            noticeIds.push(item.messageId)
        }
    })
    // 社区 问答 全部已读
    $.ajax({
        type: 'PUT',
        url: '/bbs/mark-read',
        dataType: 'json',
        data: {},
        success: function () {
            // 博客、帮助 全部已读
            if(noticeIds.length > 0){
                let ids = noticeIds.toString()
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'post',
                    url: '/blog/read',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    data: {
                        'ids': ids
                    },
                    success: function (result) {
                        handleRemoveLocalStorage()
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            getNoReadList()
                        }, 200);
                    },
                });
            } else {
                handleRemoveLocalStorage()
                setTimeout(() => {
                    getNoReadList()
                }, 200);
            }
        },
    });
}

function markOneMsgRead(el) {
    let messageId = el.dataset.id
    let ids = [messageId].toString()
    $.ajax({
        type: 'GET',
        url: '/v2/message/read',
        dataType: 'json',
        data: {
            'ids': ids
        },
        success: function () {
            handleRemoveLocalStorage()
            setTimeout(() => {
                getNoReadList()
            }, 200);
        },
    });
}

function markOneNoticeRead(el) {
    let messageId = el.dataset.id
    let type = el.dataset.type
    // 博客、帮助 动态已读
    if(Number(type) == 4 || Number(type) == 5){
        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/blog/' + messageId + '/mark-as-read',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function () {
                handleRemoveLocalStorage()
                setTimeout(() => {
                    getNoReadList()
                }, 200);
            },
        });
    } else {
        // 社区 问答 动态已读
        $.ajax({
            type: 'PUT',
            url: '/bbs/mark-read/' + messageId,
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function () {
                handleRemoveLocalStorage()
                setTimeout(() => {
                    getNoReadList()
                }, 200);
            },
        });
    }
}
function handleRemoveLocalStorage(){
    // 为兼容老版本 noReadList、isNoread、tips-time
    localStorage.removeItem("noReadList")
    localStorage.removeItem("tips-time")
    localStorage.removeItem("isNoread")
}
function getNoReadList(){
    let newTime = new Date().getTime();
    // 为兼容老版本 noReadList、isNoread、tips-time
    window.localStorage.setItem("tips-time", newTime)
    $.ajax({
        url: "/v2/common/messages",
        method: 'get',
        dataType: 'json',
        success: (result)=>{
            if (result.code == 'OK') {
                list = []
                msgList =[]
                noticeList =[]
                result.data && result.data.messages &&result.data.messages.forEach(element => {
                    let title = "";
                    let url = "";

                    switch (element.type) {
                        case 1:
                        title="公告"
                        url="/v2/message/view?id="+element.messageId
                            break;
                        case 2:
                        title="私信"
                        url="/v2/message/view?id="+element.messageId
                            break;
                        case 3:
                        case 6:
                        title="社区/问答"
                        url="/cn/bbs/"+element.topicId+"?timelineId="+element.messageId
                            break;
                        case 4:
                        title="博客"
                        url="/cn/blog/"+element.topicId+"?logId="+element.messageId
                            break;
                        case 5:
                        title="帮助"
                        url="/cn/help/"+element.topicId+"?logId="+element.messageId
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }

                    element.title = title
                    element.url = url
                    list.push(element)
                    if(element.type == 1 || element.type == 2){
                        msgList.push(element)
                    } else {
                        noticeList.push(element)
                    }
                });

                noRead = {
                    items: list,
                    noReadNum: result.data.totalCount,
                    msgList: msgList,
                    noticeList: noticeList,
                }
                // 为兼容老版本 noReadList、isNoread、tips-time
                if(result.data.totalCount <= 0){
                    window.localStorage.setItem("isNoread",true)
                }else{
                    window.localStorage.setItem("isNoread",false)
                }

                addNoReadList(noRead)
                // 为兼容老版本 noReadList、isNoread、tips-time
                window.localStorage.setItem("noReadList",JSON.stringify(noRead))
            }
        }
        }
    )
}

function addNoReadList(result){
    if(result.noReadNum > 0){
        $("#msg_none_read_bell-new").text(result.noReadNum).css('display','flex').show()
    }else{
        $("#msg_none_read_bell-new").hide()
    }    
    if(result.msgList.length > 0){
        $("#ssMsgList").empty()
        $("#ssMsgList").append($("#ssMsgListItem").tmpl(result));
        // 全部已读 可点击
        $('#readAllForMsg').addClass('ss-msg-title-active')
        // 展示未读气泡
        $("#ssMsgBtn").find(".ss-red-point").text(result.msgList.length).css( "display", "flex" );

        $("#ssMsgList").show()
        $("#ssMsgEmpty").hide()
    } else {
        // 全部已读 不可点击
        $('#readAllForMsg').removeClass('ss-msg-title-active')
        // 隐藏未读气泡
        $("#ssMsgBtn").find(".ss-red-point").css( "display", "none" );

        $("#ssMsgList").hide()
        $('#ssMsgEmpty').show()
    }
    if(result.noticeList.length > 0){
        $("#ssNoticeList").empty()
        $("#ssNoticeList").append($("#ssNoticeItem").tmpl(result));
        // 全部已读 可点击
        $('#readAllForNotice').addClass('ss-msg-title-active')
        // 展示未读气泡
        $("#ssNoticeBtn").find(".ss-red-point").text(result.noticeList.length).css( "display", "flex" );

        $("#ssNoticeList").show()
        $("#ssNoticeEmpty").hide()
    } else {
        // 全部已读 不可点击
        $('#readAllForNotice').removeClass('ss-msg-title-active')
        // 隐藏未读气泡
        $("#ssNoticeBtn").find(".ss-red-point").css( "display", "none" );

        $("#ssNoticeList").hide()
        $('#ssNoticeEmpty').show()
    }

    let activeBtnId = $('.ss-msg-btns').find('.ss-msg-btn-active').attr('id')
    
    if(activeBtnId == 'ssMsgBtn'){
        $("#ssMsg").show()
        $("#ssNotice").hide()
    } else {
        $("#ssNotice").show()
        $("#ssMsg").hide()
    }
}

// pc 端展示、收起下拉菜单
document.addEventListener('click', function(event){
    let productTrigger = document.querySelector('.ss-v2-show-product-trigger') 
    let youTrigger = document.querySelector('.ss-v2-show-youmaiyun-trigger') 
    let knowledgeTrigger = document.querySelector('.ss-v2-show-knowledge-trigger') 

    let productParentNode = document.querySelector('.ss-v2-product-sub-menu') 
    let youParentNode = document.querySelector('.ss-product-sub-menu') 
    let knowledgeParentNode = document.querySelector('.ss-knowledge-sub-menu') 

    let eTarget = event.target

    if(isShowProduct){
        if (productTrigger != eTarget 
            && !productTrigger.contains(eTarget) 
            && !productParentNode.contains(eTarget)
            && !$(eTarget).attr('class').split(/\s+/).includes('icon-gongnengquxiaoshoucang')
            && !$(eTarget).attr('class').split(/\s+/).includes('icon-gongnengshoucang')) {
            closeProductSubMenu()
            isShowProduct = false
            hideMask()
        }
    }
    if(isShowYou){
        if (youTrigger != eTarget && !youTrigger.contains(eTarget) && !youParentNode.contains(eTarget)) {
            closeYouSubMenu()
            isShowYou = false
            hideMask()
        }
    }
    if(isShowKnowledge){
        if (knowledgeTrigger != eTarget && !knowledgeTrigger.contains(eTarget) && !knowledgeParentNode.contains(eTarget)) {
            closeKnowledgeSubMenu()
            isShowKnowledge = false
            hideMask()
        }
    }
    if(!isShowProduct && !isShowYou && !isShowKnowledge){
        hideMask()
    }
})

window.addEventListener('scroll', function(e) {
    if(isShowProduct || isShowYou || isShowKnowledge){
        let scrollHeight = document.documentElement.scrollTop || document.body.scrollTop
        let hasAd = $("#add-topIPS-dynamically").length > 0
    
        let screenAdHeight = 64
        let mobileAdHeight = 30
        let ipadHeaderHeight = 98
        let screenHeaderHeight = 64
        let mobileHeaderHeight = 41
        let domWidth = window.innerWidth

        let height = 0
        if(domWidth < 480){
            height = hasAd ? (mobileHeaderHeight + mobileAdHeight) : mobileHeaderHeight 
        } else if (domWidth >= 480 && domWidth <= 850){
            height = hasAd ? (ipadHeaderHeight + screenAdHeight) : ipadHeaderHeight 
        } else {
            height = hasAd ? (screenHeaderHeight + screenAdHeight) : screenHeaderHeight 
        }
        if (height - scrollHeight > 0) {
            $('.ss-mask').css('top', height - scrollHeight)
        }else{
            $('.ss-mask').css('top', 0)
        }
    }
});

function showMask(){
    let hasAd = $("#add-topIPS-dynamically").length > 0
    
    let screenAdHeight = 64
    let mobileAdHeight = 30
    let ipadHeaderHeight = 98
    let screenHeaderHeight = 64
    let mobileHeaderHeight = 64
    let domWidth = window.innerWidth

    let height = 0
    if(domWidth < 480){
        height = hasAd ? (mobileHeaderHeight + mobileAdHeight) : mobileHeaderHeight 
    } else if (domWidth >= 480 && domWidth <= 850){
        height = hasAd ? (ipadHeaderHeight + screenAdHeight) : ipadHeaderHeight 
    } else {
        height = hasAd ? (screenHeaderHeight + screenAdHeight) : screenHeaderHeight 
    }
    $('.ss-mask').css('top', height + 'px')
    
    $('.ss-mask').show()
}
function hideMask(){
    $('.ss-mask').hide()
}

            $('#chajingpin').addClass('ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-list-item-active')
        } else if (targetClass == 'ss-knowledge-sub-menu-new-user' || targetClass == 'ss-knowledge-sub-menu-news'){
            $("." + targetClass).css("display", "flex")
        }else{
            $("." + targetClass).css("display", "block")
        }
    }
)

// 知识库 - 帮助中心 - 列表点击
$(".ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-title").click(
    function(){
        $(".ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-list").css("display", "none");
        let targetClass = $(this).attr("data-knowledge-help-target");
        $("." + targetClass).css("display", "block")
        // 箭头设置
        $('.icon-more-unfold').css("display", "none");
        $('.icon-more3').css("display", "inline");
        $(this).find('.icon-more-unfold').css("display", "inline");
        $(this).find('.icon-more3').css("display", "none");
    }
)


// 知识库 - 帮助中心 - hover
$('.ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-list-item').hover(function(){
    $('.ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-list-item').removeClass('ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-list-item-active')
    $(this).addClass('ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-left-list-item-active')

    let dataTarget = $(this).attr("data-knowledge-list");
    insertEl(helpCenterData[dataTarget])
})

// 知识库 - 插入元素
function insertEl(list){
    let elList = []
    list.forEach(function(item){
        let elIcon = item.type == 'video' ? '<i class="iconfont icon-shipin1"></i>' : '<i class="iconfont icon-wenben"></i>'
        let elText = $('<span></span>').text(item.text)
        let elLink = $('<a target="_blank"></a>').attr('href',item.link).append(elIcon, elText)
        elList.push($('<li></li>').append(elLink))
    })
    $(".ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-right-list").empty();
    $(".ss-knowledge-sub-menu-help-right-list").append(elList); 
}
</script>

    #keyword-store .el-checkbox__inner {

        transition: border-color .25s cubic-bezier(.71, -.46, .29, 1.46), background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.71, -.46, .29, 1.46);
    }

    #keyword-store .el-checkbox__input.is-checked .el-checkbox__inner {
        background-color: #fb8c1e;

    }

    #keyword-store .el-checkbox__label {
        display: inline-block;
        padding-left: 10px;
        line-height: 19px;
        font-size: 13px;
    }

    #keyword-store .el-checkbox__input.is-checked+.el-checkbox__label {
        color: #fb8c1e;
    }

    #keyword-store .el-checkbox__inner:after {
        box-sizing: content-box;
        content: "";
        border: 1px solid #fff;
        border-left: 0;
        border-top: 0;
        height: 7px;
        left: 4px;
        position: absolute;
        top: 1px;
        transform: rotate(45deg) scaleY(0);
        width: 3px;
        transition: transform .15s ease-in .05s;
        transform-origin: center;
    }

    #keyword-store .el-checkbox__input.is-checked .el-checkbox__inner:after {
        transform: rotate(45deg) scaleY(1);
    }

    /* ===== Checkbox 组 ===== */
    #keyword-store .checkbox-group,
    #keyword-store .tag-wrap {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        flex: 1;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        padding-bottom: 30px;
        position: relative;
    }

    #keyword-store .checkbox-group::-webkit-scrollbar,
    #keyword-store .tag-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
    }

    #keyword-store .checkbox-group::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,

        border-radius: 10px;
        background-color: rgba(184, 185, 188, 0.4);
        display: none;
    }

    #keyword-store .checkbox-group:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
    #keyword-store .tag-wrap:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        display: block;

    /* ===== Loading 样式 ===== */
    #keyword-store .kb-loading {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;

        bottom: 0;

        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;

    #keyword-store .kb-loading-spinner {

    #keyword-store-mask.kb-mask.show {

    #keyword-store .pagination-btn.disabled {

        min-width: 380px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        border-radius: 4px;
        border: 1px solid #ebeef5;
        position: fixed;
        left: 50%;
        top: 20px;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        background-color: #edf2fc;
        transition: opacity .3s, transform .4s, top .4s;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 8px 15px 8px 20px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .el-message--error {
        background-color: #fef0f0;
        border-color: #fde2e2;
    }

    .el-message--success {
        background-color: #f0f9ff;
        border-color: #c6f6d5;
    }

    .el-message__icon {
        margin-right: 10px;
        font-size: 16px;
    }

    .el-icon-error:before {
        content: "×";
        display: inline-block;
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        line-height: 16px;
        text-align: center;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background-color: #f56c6c;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    .el-icon-success:before {
        content: "✓";
        display: inline-block;
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        line-height: 16px;
        text-align: center;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background-color: #67c23a;
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: bold;
    }

    .el-message__content {
        padding: 0;
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: 1;
        margin: 0;
    }

    .el-message--error .el-message__content {
        color: #f56c6c;
    }

    .el-message--success .el-message__content {
        color: #67c23a;
    }

    @keyframes fadeInDown {
        from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translate(-50%, -20px);
        }
        to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translate(-50%, 0);
        }
    }
</style>

<script>
    let keywordStoreObj = {
        market: "",
        checkStoreList: [],
        labelIdList: [],
        keywordList: [],
        isAll: false,
        module: 'RS',
        params: {},
        hasMessageShowing: false,
        isSubmitting: false,

        storePagination: {
            current: 1,
            pageSize: 50,
            total: 0,
            searchKeyword: ''
        },

        labelPagination: {
            current: 1,
            pageSize: 50,
            total: 0,
            searchKeyword: ''
        },

        initLabelList: function (pageNum = 0) {
            let _this = this;
            $('#label-loading').show();
            $.ajax({
                url: `/v3/api/label/page`,
                type: "GET",
                data: {
                    module: 'KS',
                    pageNum: pageNum,
                    pageSize: _this.labelPagination.pageSize,
                    includeKeyword: _this.labelPagination.searchKeyword
                },
                success: function (res) {
                    $('#label-loading').hide();
                    if (res.code == "OK") {
                        let data = res.data || {};
                        let items = data.items || [];
                        _this.labelPagination.total = data.total || 0;
                        _this.labelPagination.current = data.page + 1;

                        $(".tag-wrap").empty();

                        items.forEach((element, index) => {
                            let position = _this.labelIdList.findIndex((e) => e == element.labelId);
                            let label = document.createElement("label");
                            let span = document.createElement("span");

                            label.className = position != -1
                                ? 'el-checkbox is-checked el-checkbox-wrap'
                                : 'el-checkbox el-checkbox-wrap';

                            label.innerHTML = position != -1
                                ? '<span class="el-checkbox__input is-checked"><span class="el-checkbox__inner"></span></span>'
                                : '<span class="el-checkbox__input"><span class="el-checkbox__inner"></span></span>';

                            span.className = "el-checkbox__label";
                            span.textContent = element.name;
                            label.appendChild(span);

                            label.onclick = function () {
                                let position1 = _this.labelIdList.findIndex((e) => e == element.labelId);
                                if (position1 == -1) {
                                    if (_this.labelIdList.length >= 4) {
                                        _this.showErrorMessage('标签数量超限，最多支持 4 个');
                                    } else {
                                        _this.labelIdList.push(element.labelId);
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    _this.labelIdList.splice(position1, 1);
                                }
                            };

                            $(".tag-wrap").append(label);
                        });

                        _this.renderLabelPagination();
                    } else {
                        _this.showErrorMessage(res.message || '加载失败');
                    }
                },
                error: function() {
                    $('#label-loading').hide();
                    _this.showErrorMessage('加载失败');
                }
            });
        },

        searchLabel: function() {
            this.labelPagination.searchKeyword = $('.label-search-input').val().trim();
            this.labelPagination.current = 1;
            this.initLabelList(0);
        },

        renderLabelPagination: function() {
            let { current, pageSize, total } = this.labelPagination;
            let totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

            if (total == 0) {
                $("#label-pagination").empty();
                return;
            }

            let startNum = (current - 1) * pageSize + 1;
            let endNum = Math.min(current * pageSize, total);
            let pagerCount = 5;
            let halfPagerCount = (pagerCount - 1) / 2;

            let html = '<div class="pagination-wrap">' +
                '<div class="pagination-info">' +
                '<span class="page-size-num">' + startNum + ' - ' + endNum + '</span>' +
                '<span class="all-page-num"> / ' + total + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="pagination-controls">' +
                '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (current <= 1 ? 'disabled' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToLabelPage(' + (current - 1) + ')">' +
                '<i class="fa fa-angle-left"></i>' +
                '</button>';

            if (totalPages <= pagerCount + 2) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (i == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToLabelPage(' + i + ')">' + i + '</button>';
                }
            } else {
                let showPrevMore = false;
                let showNextMore = false;

                if (current > pagerCount - halfPagerCount) {
                    showPrevMore = true;
                }

                if (current < totalPages - halfPagerCount) {
                    showNextMore = true;
                }

                html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (1 == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToLabelPage(1)">1</button>';

                if (showPrevMore) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn more" disabled>...</button>';
                }

                let startPage, endPage;
                if (showPrevMore && !showNextMore) {
                    startPage = totalPages - pagerCount + 1;
                    endPage = totalPages - 1;
                } else if (!showPrevMore && showNextMore) {
                    startPage = 2;
                    endPage = pagerCount;
                } else if (showPrevMore && showNextMore) {
                    startPage = current - halfPagerCount + 1;
                    endPage = current + halfPagerCount - 1;
                } else {
                    startPage = 2;
                    endPage = totalPages - 1;
                }

                for (let i = startPage; i <= endPage; i++) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (i == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToLabelPage(' + i + ')">' + i + '</button>';
                }

                if (showNextMore) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn more" disabled>...</button>';
                }

                html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (totalPages == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToLabelPage(' + totalPages + ')">' + totalPages + '</button>';
            }

            html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (current >= totalPages ? 'disabled' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToLabelPage(' + (current + 1) + ')">' +
                '<i class="fa fa-angle-right"></i>' +
                '</button>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</div>';

            $("#label-pagination").html(html);
        },

        goToLabelPage: function(page) {
            let totalPages = Math.ceil(this.labelPagination.total / this.labelPagination.pageSize);
            if (page < 1 || page > totalPages) return;
            this.initLabelList(page - 1);
        },

        saveLable: function () {
            let _this = this;
            let tag = $('#tab-keyword-tag .new-store-input').val().trim();
            if (tag) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: `/v3/api/label/add`,
                    type: "POST",
                    data: JSON.stringify({ name: tag, module: 'KS' }),
                    contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                    success: function (res) {
                        if (res.code == "OK") {
                            $('#tab-keyword-tag .new-store-input').val("");
                            if (_this.labelIdList.length < 4) {
                                _this.labelIdList.push(res.data);
                            }
                            _this.labelPagination.current = 1;
                            _this.initLabelList(0);
                            _this.showSuccessMessage('添加成功');
                        } else {
                            _this.showErrorMessage(res.message || '添加失败');
                        }
                    },
                });
            }
        },

        initStoreList: function (pageNum = 0) {
            let _this = this;
            $('#store-loading').show();
            $.ajax({
                url: `/v3/api/keyword/storehouse/page`,
                type: "POST",
                data: JSON.stringify({
                    module: _this.module,
                    pageNum: pageNum,
                    pageSize: _this.storePagination.pageSize,
                    name: _this.storePagination.searchKeyword
                }),
                contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    $('#store-loading').hide();
                    if (res.code == "OK") {
                        let data = res.data || {};
                        let items = data.items || [];
                        _this.storePagination.total = data.total || 0;
                        _this.storePagination.current = pageNum + 1;

                        $(".store-checkbox-group").empty();

                        items.forEach((element, index) => {
                            let position = _this.checkStoreList.findIndex((e) => e == element.keywordStorehouseId);
                            let label = document.createElement("label");
                            let span = document.createElement("span");
                            label.className = position != -1 ? 'el-checkbox is-checked el-checkbox-wrap' : 'el-checkbox el-checkbox-wrap';
                            label.innerHTML = position != -1
                                ? '<span class="el-checkbox__input is-checked"><span class="el-checkbox__inner"></span></span>'
                                : '<span class="el-checkbox__input"><span class="el-checkbox__inner"></span></span>';
                            span.className = "el-checkbox__label";
                            span.textContent = element.name;
                            label.appendChild(span);

                            label.onclick = function () {
                                let position1 = _this.checkStoreList.findIndex((e) => e == element.keywordStorehouseId);
                                if (position1 == -1) {
                                    _this.checkStoreList.push(element.keywordStorehouseId);
                                } else {
                                    _this.checkStoreList.splice(position1, 1);
                                }
                            };

                            $(".store-checkbox-group").append(label);
                        });

                        _this.renderStorePagination();
                    } else {
                        _this.showErrorMessage(res.message || '加载失败');
                    }
                },
                error: function() {
                    $('#store-loading').hide();
                    _this.showErrorMessage('加载失败');
                }
            });
        },

        searchStore: function() {
            this.storePagination.searchKeyword = $('.store-search-input').val().trim();
            this.storePagination.current = 1;
            this.initStoreList(0);
        },

        renderStorePagination: function() {
            let { current, pageSize, total } = this.storePagination;
            let totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

            if (total == 0) {
                $("#store-pagination").empty();
                return;
            }

            let startNum = (current - 1) * pageSize + 1;
            let endNum = Math.min(current * pageSize, total);
            let pagerCount = 5;
            let halfPagerCount = (pagerCount - 1) / 2;

            let html = '<div class="pagination-wrap">' +
                '<div class="pagination-info">' +
                '<span class="page-size-num">' + startNum + ' - ' + endNum + '</span>' +
                '<span class="all-page-num"> / ' + total + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="pagination-controls">' +
                '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (current <= 1 ? 'disabled' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToStorePage(' + (current - 1) + ')">' +
                '<i class="fa fa-angle-left"></i>' +
                '</button>';

            if (totalPages <= pagerCount + 2) {
                for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (i == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToStorePage(' + i + ')">' + i + '</button>';
                }
            } else {
                let showPrevMore = false;
                let showNextMore = false;

                if (current > pagerCount - halfPagerCount) {
                    showPrevMore = true;
                }

                if (current < totalPages - halfPagerCount) {
                    showNextMore = true;
                }

                html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (1 == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToStorePage(1)">1</button>';

                if (showPrevMore) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn more" disabled>...</button>';
                }

                let startPage, endPage;
                if (showPrevMore && !showNextMore) {
                    startPage = totalPages - pagerCount + 1;
                    endPage = totalPages - 1;
                } else if (!showPrevMore && showNextMore) {
                    startPage = 2;
                    endPage = pagerCount;
                } else if (showPrevMore && showNextMore) {
                    startPage = current - halfPagerCount + 1;
                    endPage = current + halfPagerCount - 1;
                } else {
                    startPage = 2;
                    endPage = totalPages - 1;
                }

                for (let i = startPage; i <= endPage; i++) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (i == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToStorePage(' + i + ')">' + i + '</button>';
                }

                if (showNextMore) {
                    html += '<button class="pagination-btn more" disabled>...</button>';
                }

                html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (totalPages == current ? 'active' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToStorePage(' + totalPages + ')">' + totalPages + '</button>';
            }

            html += '<button class="pagination-btn ' + (current >= totalPages ? 'disabled' : '') + '" onclick="keywordStoreObj.goToStorePage(' + (current + 1) + ')">' +
                '<i class="fa fa-angle-right"></i>' +
                '</button>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</div>';

            $("#store-pagination").html(html);
        },

        goToStorePage: function(page) {
            let totalPages = Math.ceil(this.storePagination.total / this.storePagination.pageSize);
            if (page < 1 || page > totalPages) return;
            this.initStoreList(page - 1);
        },

        saveStore: function () {
            let _this = this;
            let value = $('.new-store-input').first().val().trim();
            if (value) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: `/v3/api/keyword/storehouse/add`,
                    type: "POST",
                    data: JSON.stringify({
                        name: value,
                        market: _this.market,
                        module: _this.module
                    }),
                    contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                    success: function (res) {
                        if (res.code == "OK") {
                            _this.checkStoreList.push(res.data);
                            $('.new-store-input').first().val("");
                            _this.storePagination.current = 1;
                            _this.initStoreList(0);
                            _this.showSuccessMessage('添加成功');
                        } else {
                            _this.showErrorMessage(res.message || '添加失败');
                        }
                    },
                });
            }
        },

        saveKeyword: function () {
            let _this = this;

            if (_this.isSubmitting) {
                return;
            }

            if (_this.checkStoreList.length == 0) {
                _this.showErrorMessage('请选择词库');
                return;
            }

            if (_this.labelIdList.length > 4) {
                _this.showErrorMessage('标签数量超限，最多支持 4 个');
                return;
            }

            if (!_this.isAll) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: `/v3/api/keyword/storehouse/keyword/add-new`,
                    type: "POST",
                    contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                    data: JSON.stringify({
                        keywordList: _this.keywordList,
                        keywordStorehouseIdList: _this.checkStoreList,
                        labelIdList: _this.labelIdList,
                    }),
                    success: function (res) {
                        if (res.code == "OK") {
                            _this.showSuccessMessage('添加成功');
                            _this.reset();
                            $('.keyword-store-close').click();
                        } else {
                            _this.showErrorMessage(res.message || '添加失败');
                        }
                    },
                });
            } else {
                _this.disableSubmit();
                $.ajax({
                    url: `/v3/api/keyword/storehouse/batch/import`,
                    type: "POST",
                    contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                    data: JSON.stringify({
                        module: _this.module,
                        params: _this.params,
                        market: _this.params.station,
                        storeIdList: _this.checkStoreList,
                        labelIdList: _this.labelIdList,
                    }),
                    success: function (res) {
                        _this.enableSubmit();
                        if (res.code == "OK") {
                            _this.showSuccessMessage('添加成功');
                            _this.reset();
                            $('.keyword-store-close').click();
                        } else {
                            _this.showErrorMessage(res.message || '添加失败');
                        }
                    },
                    error: function() {
                        _this.enableSubmit();
                        _this.showErrorMessage('请求失败，请重试');
                    }
                });
            }
        },

        reset: function() {
            this.checkStoreList = [];
            this.labelIdList = [];
            this.storePagination.searchKeyword = '';
            this.labelPagination.searchKeyword = '';
            $('.store-search-input').val('');
            $('.label-search-input').val('');
        },

        showErrorMessage: function(message) {
            let _this = this;
            _this.hasMessageShowing = true;

            let errorEl = $('<div class="el-message el-message--error" style="pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer;">' +
                '<i class="el-message__icon el-icon-error"></i>' +
                '<p class="el-message__content">' + message + '</p>' +
                '</div>');

            $('body').append(errorEl);
            errorEl.css({
                'position': 'fixed',
                'top': '20px',
                'left': '50%',
                'transform': 'translateX(-50%)',
                'z-index': '99999999',
                'animation': 'fadeInDown 0.3s'
            });

            let timeoutId = setTimeout(function() {
                errorEl.fadeOut(300, function() {
                    $(this).remove();
                    _this.hasMessageShowing = false;
                });
            }, 3000);

            errorEl.on('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                errorEl.fadeOut(300, function() {
                    $(this).remove();
                    _this.hasMessageShowing = false;
                });
            });
        },

        showSuccessMessage: function(message) {
            let _this = this;
            _this.hasMessageShowing = true;

            let successEl = $('<div class="el-message el-message--success" style="pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer;">' +
                '<i class="el-message__icon el-icon-success"></i>' +
                '<p class="el-message__content">' + message + '</p>' +
                '</div>');

            $('body').append(successEl);
            successEl.css({
                'position': 'fixed',
                'top': '20px',
                'left': '50%',
                'transform': 'translateX(-50%)',
                'z-index': '99999999',
                'animation': 'fadeInDown 0.3s'
            });

            let timeoutId = setTimeout(function() {
                successEl.fadeOut(300, function() {
                    $(this).remove();
                    _this.hasMessageShowing = false;
                });
            }, 3000);

            successEl.on('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                successEl.fadeOut(300, function() {
                    $(this).remove();
                    _this.hasMessageShowing = false;
                });
            });
        },

        showWarningMessage: function(message) {
            let _this = this;
            _this.hasMessageShowing = true;

            let warningEl = $('<div class="el-message el-message--warning" style="pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer;">' +
                '<i class="el-message__icon el-icon-warning"></i>' +
                '<p class="el-message__content">' + message + '</p>' +
                '</div>');

            $('body').append(warningEl);
            warningEl.css({
                'position': 'fixed',
                'top': '20px',
                'left': '50%',
                'transform': 'translateX(-50%)',
                'z-index': '99999999',
                'animation': 'fadeInDown 0.3s'
            });

            let timeoutId = setTimeout(function() {
                warningEl.fadeOut(300, function() {
                    $(this).remove();
                    _this.hasMessageShowing = false;
                });
            }, 3000);

            warningEl.on('click', function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                warningEl.fadeOut(300, function() {
                    $(this).remove();
                    _this.hasMessageShowing = false;
                });
            });
        },

        disableSubmit: function() {
            this.isSubmitting = true;
            $('#keyword-store-submit-btn').prop('disabled', true);
        },

        enableSubmit: function() {
            this.isSubmitting = false;
            $('#keyword-store-submit-btn').prop('disabled', false);
        }
    };

    function initKeywordStoreData(market, keywordList, module = 'RS') {
        keywordStoreObj.market = market;
        keywordStoreObj.keywordList = keywordList;
        keywordStoreObj.module = module;
        keywordStoreObj.isAll = false;
        keywordStoreObj.reset();
        keywordStoreObj.initLabelList(0);
        keywordStoreObj.initStoreList(0);
    }

    function allKeywordStoreData(market, keywordList, module, isAll, params) {
        keywordStoreObj.isAll = isAll;
        keywordStoreObj.module = module;
        keywordStoreObj.params = params;
        keywordStoreObj.market = market;
        keywordStoreObj.keywordList = keywordList;
        keywordStoreObj.reset();
        keywordStoreObj.initLabelList(0);
        keywordStoreObj.initStoreList(0);
    }

    $(document).ready(function() {
        // 监听侧边栏显示/隐藏，同步控制遮罩层
        const keywordStore = document.getElementById('keyword-store');
        const mask = document.getElementById('keyword-store-mask');
        let isClosingByMask = false;

        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                if (mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                    const isHidden = keywordStore.classList.contains('u-unfold--hidden');
                    if (isHidden) {
                        // 如果是点击遮罩层触发的关闭，不再重复操作遮罩层
                        if (!isClosingByMask) {
                            mask.classList.remove('show');
                        }
                        isClosingByMask = false;
                    } else {
                        mask.classList.add('show');
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        observer.observe(keywordStore, { attributes: true });

        // 点击遮罩层关闭侧边栏
        $('#keyword-store-mask').on('click', function() {
            isClosingByMask = true;
            mask.classList.remove('show');
            // 稍微延迟一下，让遮罩层动画先开始
            setTimeout(function() {
                $('.keyword-store-close').click();
            }, 10);
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (keywordStoreObj.hasMessageShowing) {
                let isMessageClick = $(e.target).closest('.el-message').length > 0;
                let isKeywordStoreClick = $(e.target).closest('#keyword-store').length > 0;

                if (!isMessageClick && !isKeywordStoreClick) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    e.preventDefault();
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }, true);

        $('.kb-tabs-title').on('click', function() {
            let tab = $(this).data('tab');
            $('.kb-tabs-title').removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active');
            $('.kb-tab-content').removeClass('active');
            $('#tab-' + tab).addClass('active');
        });

        $("#keyword-store").on("click", '.store-checkbox-group .el-checkbox-wrap', function () {
            let hasChecked = $(this).hasClass("is-checked");
            if (hasChecked) {
                $(this).removeClass("is-checked");
                $(this).find(".el-checkbox__input").removeClass("is-checked");
            } else {
                $(this).addClass("is-checked");
                $(this).find(".el-checkbox__input").addClass("is-checked");
            }
        });

        $("#keyword-store").on("click", '.tag-wrap .el-checkbox-wrap', function () {
            let hasChecked = $(this).hasClass("is-checked");
            if (hasChecked) {
                $(this).removeClass("is-checked");
                $(this).find(".el-checkbox__input").removeClass("is-checked");
            } else {
                $(this).addClass("is-checked");
                $(this).find(".el-checkbox__input").addClass("is-checked");
            }
        });

        $("#keyword-store").on("keyup", '#tab-keyword-bank .new-store-input', function (e) {
            if (e.keyCode == 13) {
                keywordStoreObj.saveStore();
            }
        });

        $("#keyword-store").on("keyup", '#tab-keyword-tag .new-store-input', function (e) {
            if (e.keyCode == 13) {
                keywordStoreObj.saveLable();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script src="/assets-frontend/vendor/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script src="/assets-v2/js/jalc.min.js"></script>

<script>
    var interval = null;
    var timeoutId = null;
    $('#solve-img-load-modal').addClass('fade-in-bottom');
    /**
     * @description: hide img failed module e.stopPropagation()
     * @param {*}
     * @return {*}
     */
    $('#solve-img-load-modal-close').click(function (event) {
        window.clearInterval(interval);
        $('#solve-img-load-modal').removeClass('fade-in-bottom').addClass('fade-out-bottom');
        // $('#solve-img-load-modal').hide();
        close()
        event.stopPropagation();
    })
    $('#solve-img-load-link-a').click(function (event) {
        window.clearInterval(interval);
        read()
        $('#solve-img-load-modal').hide();
        event.stopPropagation();
    })
    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }

    /**
     * @description: 获取数据
     * @param {*}
     * @return {*}
     */
    let noticeId;
    let cacheKey = "corner_notice"

    function getData() {
        let url = '/v2/corner-popup/one';
        // 1小时请求一次
        let local_cached_hour_key = 'CORNER_POPUP_HIT_HOUR_TIME',
            cached = localStorage.getItem(local_cached_hour_key);
        try{if (cached != null && new Date(parseInt(cached)).getTime() > new Date().getTime() - 3600000) return false;}catch (e) {}

        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'get',
            data: '',
            cache: true,
            async: true,
            dataType: 'json',
            contentType: 'application/json',
            localCache: true,
            cacheTTL: 0.05,  // Optional. In hours. Can be used with float to indicate part of an hour, e.g. 0.5.
            cacheKey: cacheKey,
            isCacheValid: function () {
                // 响应有无notice数据均缓存3分钟
                return true;
            }
            // ,
            // isResponseValid: function (data, status, jqXHR) {  // optional.
            //     console.log(data)
            //     return data.code === 'OK' && data.data;
            // },
        }).then(function (data) {
            if (data.code == "OK") {
                if (data.code === "OK") localStorage.setItem(local_cached_hour_key, new Date().getTime());

                //     console.log(data);
                noticeId = data.noticeId;
                if (data.data) {
                    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    localStorage.removeItem(local_cached_hour_key);

                    interval = setInterval(function () {
                        $('#solve-img-load-modal').removeClass('modal-hide').addClass('modal-show');
                        let scrollHeight = $('.solve-img-load-modal-content')[0].scrollHeight;
                        // console.log(scrollHeight);
                        if (scrollHeight > 110) {
                            $('#see-more').removeClass('visible-hide').addClass('visible-show')
                        }
                        
                        },1500);
                        $('.solve-img-load-modal-title').text(data.title);
                        $('.solve-img-load-modal-content').html(data.content);
                        $('#see-more').text(data.seeMoreTitle);
                        $('.solve-img-load-link-a').text(data.buttonTitle);
                        // 标记弹窗时间
                        localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                        if(data.url){
                           $('.solve-img-load-link-a').attr('target',"_blank");
                           $('.solve-img-load-link-a').attr('href',data.url);
                        }
                       
                      }
            
                } else {       
                  // swal({
                  //   title: '数据获取失败',
                  //   text: data.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',
                  //   type: 'error',
                  //   showConfirmButton:false,
                  //   timer:1500
                  // });
                  console.warn(data);
                }
            })
      }
      timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
        let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
        let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
        console.log(flag,'popViewModal')
        if(!flag) return;
        getData();
      },3000)
      function read(){
          clearCache(cacheKey);
          let url = '/v2/corner-popup/'+ noticeId + '/read';
          $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'get',
            data: '',
            cache: true,
            async: true,
            dataType: 'json',
            contentType: 'application/json',
        }).then(function (data) {
            // 标记弹窗时间
            localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
            if (data.code == "OK") {
                //     console.log(data);
            } else {
                console.warn(data);
            }
        })
    }

    function close() {
        clearCache(cacheKey);
        let url = '/v2/corner-popup/' + noticeId + '/close';
        if (!noticeId) {
            console.warn('[backend] /v2/corner-popup/:noticeId/close 中的noticeId传值有问题，不发起请求 @庄总 20251027');
            return;
        }
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'get',
            data: '',
            cache: true,
            async: true,
            dataType: 'json',
            contentType: 'application/json',
        }).then(function (data) {
            // 标记弹窗时间
            localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
            if (data.code == "OK") {
                //     console.log(data);
            } else {
                console.warn(data);
            }
        })
    }

    /**
     *  清除缓存
     * @param key 缓存的key
     */
    function clearCache(key){
        localStorage.removeItem(key + "cachettl");
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
    }
</script><!-- 亚马逊图片无法加载的解决方案全局弹窗end  -->

<script>

    $(function(){
        getNoReadList()
        let isShowTip= window.localStorage.getItem("isShowTip")||true
        $('#check-tips-btn .checkbox-switch__input').prop('checked',eval(isShowTip))
        console.log(isShowTip)
        if(eval(isShowTip)){
        } else {
            let style = document.createElement("style");
            style.type = "text/css";
            style.id = "hide-tooltip";
            style.innerHTML =
                ".tooltip,.popover.tips-dark{display: none;}.popover.tips-dark.show-tooltip{display: block ;}";
            document.querySelector("body").appendChild(style);
        }
        var timeoutId = null;
        // 送书活动测试
        function showTryThreeQr(){
            if(!document.getElementById('remindType')) return;
            let remindType = $('#remindType').val();
            let REMIND_UNPAID = (window.localStorage.getItem('REMIND_UNPAID_KEY')? window.localStorage.getItem('REMIND_UNPAID_KEY') : '')
            if( remindType == 'UNPAID' && !REMIND_UNPAID){
                $("#modal-try-three-qr").modal("show")
                // 标记弹窗时间
                localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            }
        }
        function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
            let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
            const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
            return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
        }
        timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
            let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
            let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
            if(!flag) return;
            showTryThreeQr();
        },2000)
        $("#modal-try-three-qr-close").click(function(){
            window.localStorage.setItem('REMIND_UNPAID_KEY','REMIND_UNPAID')
            $('#modal-try-three-qr').modal('hide');
            // 标记弹窗时间
            localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
        });
    })
    // function clearUpdateTips() {
    //     $('.update-tips').remove()
    //     window.localStorage.setItem("updateTips",true)
    // }
    // 包含所有变体
    $('#check-tips-btn').on("click", ".checkbox-switch__input", function () {
        let isChecked = $('#check-tips-btn .checkbox-switch__input').prop('checked');
        if(isChecked){
            window.localStorage.setItem("isShowTip", true)
            document.getElementById("hide-tooltip").remove();
        } else {
            let style = document.createElement("style");
            style.type = "text/css";
            style.id = "hide-tooltip";
            style.innerHTML =
                ".tooltip,.popover.tips-dark{display: none;}.popover.tips-dark.show-tooltip{display: block ;}";
            document.querySelector("body").appendChild(style);
            window.localStorage.setItem("isShowTip", false)

        }
    })
</script>

                    <div class="card-body text-secondary">
                        <div class="row mt-3">
                            <div class="col-12 col-md-12 col-xl-6">
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4" style="min-height: 38px;">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">月搜索量</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>指一个自然月，比如2023年7月，该关键词在亚马逊站内的搜索次数<br></p><p>搜索量是市场需求的最直接反映，如果要选择潜力爆款(处于市场导入期和成长期)，一般是选择搜索量不是很大但增长很快的关键词</p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm" name="minSearches" value="" type="number" min="1" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm" name="maxSearches" value="" type="number" min="1" max="100000000" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-3">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">月搜索量<br/>同比增长值</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>同比搜索量增长值 = (今年)当月搜索量-(去年)该月搜索量<br><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>比如现在是2023年7月，当月关键词搜索量为100000</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>2022年7月关键词搜索量为60000<br>则同比搜索量增长值 = 100000-60000=40000</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>增长值越大表示该市场越有潜力，但是要注意该关键词是否属于季节性词</span></p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm" name="minYearlyGrowth" value="10" min="0" type="number" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxYearlyGrowth" value="200" min="1" max="40000000" type="number" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-3">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">月搜索量<br/>近3个月增长值</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>取最近三个月每月的增长值，最后以最小增长值作为近3个月搜索量增长值<br><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>比如：<br>202304=10000，202305=12000，增长值=2000<br>202306=13000，增长值=1000<br>202307=20000，增长值=7000<br>最后取最小值1000为近3个月搜索量月增长值<br></span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>关键词本质上代表了一个细分市场，近3个月搜索量月增长值可以帮您选出潜力市场</span></p><p><br><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>扩展阅读：</span><a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-searches-growth-rate-last-3-months&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何找出近期搜索量持续增长的潜力市场？</a><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>（</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>图文+视频</span>）</span></span></p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm" name="minGrowthTrendMin" value="" min="0" type="number" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxGrowthTrendMin" value="" min="1" max="40000000" type="number" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4" style="min-height: 30.47px;">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">新细分市场</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>新出现的细分市场，表示(今年)当月有该关键词的搜索量，而去年该月没有该<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>关键词的搜索量</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>该过滤条件可以用来寻找新的细分市场</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>扩展阅读：</span><a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/blog/how-to-understand-new-subdivided-markets&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何筛选出新兴的潜力市场？</a><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>（图文+视频）</span></p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox">
                                            <input name="withYearlyGrowth"  value="false" type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" id="checkbox-withYearlyGrowth"  >
                                            <label for="checkbox-withYearlyGrowth" class="custom-control-label">仅包含该市场
                                            </label>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">商品数</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>用户搜索该关键词后，搜索结果下有多少件相关商品(All Departments类目)<br>搜索结果数直接反映了该关键词(细分行业)下的产品供应量<br>注意：供应量大未必代表需求方竞争大，比如iphone case有9万搜索结果，iphone xr case有2万搜索结果，但后者明显比前者竞争大(可以参考关键词的搜索量、PPC价格)</p><p><br></p><p>点击了解：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-distinguish-total-products-from-search-results&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;&quot;>类目商品数和搜索结果数的区别</a><br></p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm" name="minProducts" value="" min="0" type="number" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxProducts" value="" min="1" max="30000000" type="number" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4 keywordsIsHide">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">购买量</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<div class=&quot;ace-line ace-line old-record-id-MwcKdwWsQoaG4gxwdy8cZfCBnRg&quot; style=&quot;&quot;><p style=&quot;&quot;>月购买量，指一个自然月，比如2023年7月，在亚马逊站内搜索该关键词后产生购买的次数</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>比如：某用户搜索iphone charger，然后1次购买了1个iphone充电器，2条数据线(关联推荐的商品)，则购买量=1</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>购买量 = 搜索量*购买率</p></div>' ></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minPurchases" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')" type="number" min="0" placeholder="最小值">

                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="maxPurchases" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')" type="number" placeholder="最大值" min="1" max="30000000">

                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4 ">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">展示量</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>指一个自然月，比如2024年3月，在某个关键词搜索结果页中所有ASIN的总展示次数</p><p>非单个ASIN在关键词下的曝光量</p>' ></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minImpressions" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')" type="number" min="0" placeholder="最小值">

                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="maxImpressions" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')" type="number" placeholder="最大值" min="1" max="30000000">

                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4 keywordsIsHide">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">SPR</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p><span data-lark-record-data=&quot;{&quot; rootid&quot;:&quot;doxcnhhiomhymmyuavclrbpcgvd&quot;,&quot;text&quot;:{&quot;initialattributedtexts&quot;:{&quot;text&quot;:{&quot;0&quot;:&quot;keyword-mining.filter.spr&quot;},&quot;attribs&quot;:{&quot;0&quot;:&quot;*0+p&quot;}},&quot;apool&quot;:{&quot;numtoattrib&quot;:{&quot;0&quot;:[&quot;author&quot;,&quot;6959558576163536897&quot;]},&quot;nextnum&quot;:1}},&quot;type&quot;:&quot;text&quot;,&quot;referencerecordmap&quot;:{},&quot;extra&quot;:{&quot;mention_page_title&quot;:{},&quot;external_mention_url&quot;:{}},&quot;iscut&quot;:false}&quot;=&quot;&quot; data-lark-record-format=&quot;docx/text&quot; class=&quot;lark-record-clipboard&quot;></span></p><div data-page-id=&quot;doxcnhHIomHYmMYuaVClrbPCgVd&quot; data-docx-has-block-data=&quot;false&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn04q4eks4e0MoIt3X9KIsQg&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn04q4eks4e0MoIt3X9KIsQg&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn04q4eks4e0MoIt3X9KIsQg&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnUA2AsO8iEEKoy80BfkZPjc&quot;>SellerSprite Product Rank，能够让该关键词排名维持在搜索结果第1页的8天预估单量</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnUA2AsO8iEEKoy80BfkZPjc&quot;>比如SPR=280，则代表产品8天内该关键词下的出单量需要达到280，才能让该关键词排名维持在搜索结果第1页</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnUA2AsO8iEEKoy80BfkZPjc&quot;><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnUA2AsO8iEEKoy80BfkZPjc&quot;>SPR数值越大，表示让关键词排名维持在首页的单量要求更高，竞争更激烈</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnUA2AsO8iEEKoy80BfkZPjc&quot;>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-spr&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何让关键词排名快速上首页？</a></div></div></div></div></div>' ></span>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">货流值</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>货流值&nbsp; =&nbsp; 历史最高PPC竞价(短语匹配)/点击排名前3 ASIN的价格中位数*100%<br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>货流值越低，意味着该细分行业引流成本越低，竞争越小，也可能意味着该市场还处于蓝海</p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/blog/how-to-understand-traffic-efficiency&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何通过流量成本大小判断市场竞争程度？</a>（图文+视频）</p>' ></span>
