                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minGoodsValue" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>

                                            <div class="input-group-append">

                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">价格</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>关键词在亚马逊搜索结果点击排名前3的ASIN中<span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>，得到的中位数价格</span></p><p>比如点击排名前3ASIN的价格分别是A$15.8、A$22.9、A$17.99，则中位数价格为A$17.99<br></p><p>可以判断哪个价格区间可能还有机会(价格差异化)，以及哪个价格区间竞争最为激烈</p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center"  name="minAvgPrice" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">

                                            </div>
                                        </div>

                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center"  name="maxAvgPrice" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最大值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light change-currency-unit" data-toggle="tooltip" title="">$</span>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">评分数</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>关键词在亚马逊搜索结果点击排名前3的ASIN中</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>，</span>得到的中位数评分数</p><p>比如点击排名前3的ASIN的评分数分别是1956、568、275，则中位数评分数为568<br></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>评分数</span>是市场打造新品难度的直接反映，如果中低评分数区间占比较大，说明新品进入壁垒不高</p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="minAvgReviews" value="" min="0" type="number" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxAvgReviews" value="" min="0" max="40000000" type="number" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">单词个数</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>关键词词组的单词个数，以空格区分</p><p>比如iphone11 case单词个数为2，airpods pro case单词个数为3</p><p>最小值只能输入1-5的整数，最大值只能输入1-9个整数</p><p><br></p><p>可以基于大词(词根)或长尾词(精准词)筛选出细分市场</p><p>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/v3/knowledge/feature/how-to-use-word-count&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何基于大词或长尾词筛选出细分市场？</a></p><p>(该数据从2021年1月开始支持)</p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="minWordCount" value="" min="1" onkeyup="getWordCount(event,'min')"  type="number" max="5" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxWordCount" value="" min="1" max="9" onkeyup="getWordCount(event,'max')" type="number" placeholder="最大值">

                            <div class="col-12 col-md-12 col-xl-6">

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">月搜索量<br/>增长率</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>指当月相比上月该关键词搜索量(全站而非某类目下)增长的百分比，比如上月该关键词搜索量1.0万，本月1.2万，则搜索增长率 = (1.2-1.0)/1.0 * 100% = 20%<br>该过滤条件可以用来寻找潜力爆款(上升期)，如果选择某类目+搜索增长率+搜索量，则一份类目关键词飙升榜随即出炉<br></p>' ></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minGrowth" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="maxGrowth" value="" placeholder="最大值" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-3">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">月搜索量<br/>同比增长率</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>同比搜索量增长率 = (今年当月搜索量-去年该月搜索量)/去年该月搜索量*100%<br><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>比如现在是2023年7月，当月关键词搜索量为100000<br>2022年7月的关键词搜索量为60000</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>则同比搜索量增长率 = (100000-60000)/60000*100% = 66.67%</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>通过同比搜索量增长率可以帮您选出新的市场，最好结合增长值综合判断</span></p>' ></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minYearlyGrowthRate" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="maxYearlyGrowthRate" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最大值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-3" style="height: 38px;">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">月搜索量<br/>近3个月增长率</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>取最近三个月每月的增长率，最后以最小增长率作为近3个月搜索量增长率<br><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>比如：<br>202304=10000，202305=12000，增长率=(12000-10000)/10000=20%<br>202306=13000，增长率=1000/12000=8.33%<br>202307=20000，增长率=7000/13000=53.85%<br>最后取最小值8.33%为近3个月搜索量月增长率<br></span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>增长率是该关键词近3个月搜索量飙升的直接反映，通过近3个月搜索量增长率可以帮您选出潜力市场</span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p><p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>扩展阅读：</span><a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-searches-growth-rate-last-3-months&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何找出近期搜索量持续增长的潜力市场？</a><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>（</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>图文+视频</span>）</span></span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p>' ></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minGrowthRateTrendMin" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'minGrowthRateTrendMin')" type="text" onblur="blurclearNoNum(this,'minGrowthRateTrendMin')" placeholder="最小值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="maxGrowthRateTrendMin" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'maxGrowthRateTrendMin')" type="text" onblur="blurclearNoNum(this,'maxGrowthRateTrendMin')" placeholder="最大值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                 <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">市场周期</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>季节性市场：该关键词最近12个月的月搜索量，按照搜索量降序排列，取得<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>最高</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>搜索量&nbsp;</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>h1，如果(h1-平均值)/平均值&gt;1，</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>则该市场为季节性市场</span></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>持续增长市场：该关键词最近6个月有5-6个月，月搜索量增长率大于5%的市场</p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>持续衰退市场：<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>该关键词</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>最近6个月有5-6个月，月搜索量增长率小于-5%的市场</span></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>一般性市场：不属于以上情况的市场，均为一般性市场</p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                            <select name="marketPeriod" class="form-control form-control-xs item-select-sm">
                                                <option value="" selected>不限</option>
                                                <option value="N" >一般性市场</option>
                                                <option value="S1,S2,S3" >季节性市场(1-3月旺季)</option>
                                                <option value="S4,S5,S6" >季节性市场(4-6月旺季)</option>
                                                <option value="S7,S8,S9" >季节性市场(7-9月旺季)</option>
                                                <option value="S10,S11,S12" >季节性市场(10-12月旺季)</option>
                                                <option value="I" >持续增长市场</option>
                                                <option value="D" >持续衰退市场</option>
                                            </select>
                                        </div>
                                  </div>

                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">需供比</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;><p style=&quot;&quot;>需供比 = 搜索量(需求) / 商品数(供应)</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>在同类市场中，需供比值越高，则代表该市场需求越强劲</p><p style=&quot;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;&quot;>比如关键词phone holder的月搜索量为69,465，商品数为14,875</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>则该关键词对应细分市场的需供比为69,465/14,875=4.7</p></div>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="minSupplyDemandRatio" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxSupplyDemandRatio" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>
                                </div>


                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4 keywordsIsHide">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">购买率</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>购买率是用户购买意愿和决策周期的直观反映，数据来源于亚马逊后台的商品机会探测器<br></p><p><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>购买率，购买率=购买量/搜索量，指的是在买家输入该搜索词并点击此细分市场中的任意商品后，买家的购买次数占买家输入该搜索词总次数的比例，<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/v3/knowledge/feature/how-to-understand-purchase-rate&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>详细了解</a><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>比如关键词wireless charger，一个月内被搜索了120万次，共产生了1.6万次销售(未必全部是无线充电器，也可能是数据线)，则该词的购买率 = 1.6万/120万=1.33%</p>' ></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="minPurchaseRate" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <div class="input-group input-group-xs item-inputs-sm" >
                                            <input class="form-control text-center" name="maxPurchaseRate" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最大值">
                                            <div class="input-group-append">
                                                <span class="input-group-text px-1 bg-light">%</span>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center mt-4">
                                    <span class="text-nowrap span-label-filter">点击量</span>
                                    <span class="text-primary fal fa-question-circle ml-2" data-tips-class="tips-dark" data-tips='<p>指一个自然月，比如2024年3月，在某个关键词搜索结果页中被点击的总次数</p><p>非单个ASIN在关键词下的点击量</p>'></span>
                                    <div class="ml-4 d-flex align-items-center">
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="minClicks" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最小值">
                                        <span class="text-muted mx-2">~</span>
                                        <input class="form-control form-control-xs item-inputs-sm"  name="maxClicks" value="" onkeyup="clearNoNum(this,'')"  type="text" placeholder="最大值">
                                    </div>

                            data-tips='<div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnKOgW622oksuwo5fiWo6oug&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnKOgW622oksuwo5fiWo6oug&quot;>勾选后展示每个关键词在亚马逊前台搜索结果下的Top10产品图片（自然搜索结果）</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnKOgW622oksuwo5fiWo6oug&quot;>通过对比Top10产品的外观，可以批量快速判断该关键词是否与自己运营的产品相关</div></div>'></span>

                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>最近2-3年该关键词的月度搜索量趋势<br>对于季节性或趋势性关键词，可能只在最近2年某几个月出现，则其它月份搜索量填充0<br>对于月搜索量为0的关键词，表示该关键词搜索量太小，没有达到收录阈值</p><p><br></p><p>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-trends&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何通过搜索趋势判断买家需求？</a><br></p>'></span>

                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        月搜索量
                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>指一个自然月，比如2023年7月，<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>该关键词</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>在亚马逊站内的搜索次数</span></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>搜索量一定要结合搜索趋势看才更客观，</span>每月月初更新上个月的数据<span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><br></span></p>'></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center ">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        月购买量<br/>
                        购买率
                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>上行：月购买量，指一个自然月，比如2023年7月，在亚马逊站内搜索该关键词后产生购买的次数</p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>比如：某用户搜索iphone charger，然后1次购买了1个iphone充电器，2条数据线(关联推荐的商品)，则购买量=1</p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>购买量 = 搜索量*购买率</p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>下行：购买率，指的是在买家输入该搜索词并点击此细分市场中的任意商品后，买家的购买次数占买家输入该搜索词总次数的比例，<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/v3/knowledge/feature/how-to-understand-purchase-rate&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>详细了解</a></p><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>比如关键词wireless charger，一个月内被搜索了120万次，共产生了1.6万次销售(未必全部是无线充电器，也可能是数据线)，则该词的购买率 = 1.6万/120万=1.33%</p><div data-zone-id=&quot;0&quot; data-line-index=&quot;1&quot;>一般反映了该关键词的精准度，越精准、用户决策周期越短的产品，购买率越高</div>'></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center ">
                        <div class="text-nowrap">
                            展示量<br/>
                            点击量
                            <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<p>上行：指一个自然月，比如2024年3月，在某个关键词搜索结果页中所有ASIN的总展示次数</p><p>非单个ASIN在关键词下的曝光量</p><p><br></p><p>下行：指一个自然月，比如2024年3月，在某个关键词搜索结果页中被点击的总次数</p><p>非单个ASIN在关键词下的点击量</p>'></span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </th>
                <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="order-field d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center ">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        增长率
                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>指本月搜索量相对于上月增长的百分比<br><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>比如：某关键词上月搜索量是100万，本月是120万，则搜索增长率为 = (120万-100万)/100万=20%</span></p><p>搜索增长较快，可能是因为季节性、节日性，事件性，也可能真的是潜力爆款(结合搜索量趋势)<br></p>'></span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="8%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center ">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        <div>
                            同比增长<br/>近3月增长
                            <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<p>上行：月搜索量同比增长值、增长率(括号内)；同比搜索量增长值 = (今年)当月搜索量-(去年)该月搜索量</p><p>例：2024年7月，当月关键词搜索量为100000；2023年7月关键词搜索量为60000，月搜索量同比增长值为100000-60000=40000;增长率为40000/60000*100%=66.67%</p><p><br></p><p>增长值越大表示该市场越有潜力，但是要注意该关键词是否属于季节性词</p><p><br></p><p>下行：月搜索量近3个月增长值、增长率(括号内)；取最近三个月每月的增长值，最后以最小增长值作为近3个月搜索量增长值</p><p>例：2024年7月10000，8月12000，增长值=2000，增长率为2000/10000*100%=20%；</p><p>按此计算，假设6/7/8/9月份的月搜索量分别为7000/10000/12000/18000，则7-9月的搜索量月增长值分别为3000/2000/6000，取最小值2000为近3个月搜索量月增长值；</p><p>7-9月份的月搜索量增长率分别为3000/7000=42.8%，2000/10000=20%，6000/18000=50%，取最小值20%为近3个月搜索量月增长率</p><p><br></p><div data-page-id=&quot;LQ6kdSlSxohMNyxuoq9cKw06nEf&quot; data-lark-html-role=&quot;root&quot; data-docx-has-block-data=&quot;false&quot;><div class=&quot;ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QzKAd4bUfoxbNtxDKgdcvfK4ndf&quot;><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>通过近3个月搜索量月增长值和增长率可以发现近3个月飙升较快的关键词，能够迅速帮您找到潜力市场</span></p><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>扩展阅读：</span><a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-searches-growth-rate-last-3-months&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何找出近期搜索量持续增长的潜力市场？</a><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>（</span><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;><span style=&quot;font-size: inherit;&quot;>图文+视频</span>）</span></span></div></div>'></span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>

            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center ">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        <div class="text-nowrap">
                            ABA <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                     data-tips='<div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>数据来源：亚马逊后台的ABA数据报告</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>数据范围：当时间范围选择按周时，ABA集中度取最近一周的数据</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>选择历史月份时如 2025-02，ABA集中度则为当月对应的数据</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>上行：点击总占比，指该关键词下点击排名前三ASIN的点击总占比</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>一般来说，点击总占比越高，该词垄断程度越高</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/help/how-to-understand-click-concentration&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何快速判断细分市场垄断程度？</a><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>假设点击前三ASIN的点击共享分别是13.9%、12.4%、11.1%</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>则前三ASIN点击总占比=13.9%+12.4%+11.1%=37.4%</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>下行：转化总占比，指的是该关键词下点击排名前三ASIN的转化共享之和</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>（转化共享，指的是该ASIN在这个关键词下的销量占整个词销量的比例）</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>假设点击前三ASIN的转化共享分别是18.4%、10.9%、5.6%</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcnuKUgc24qWo2aqwhGyoZSKe&quot;>则前三ASIN转化总占比=18.4%+10.9%+5.6%=34.9%</div>'></span>
                            <br/>集中度
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center ">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        <div class="text-nowrap">
                            ABA <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                      data-tips='<p>关键词的月度ABA排名<br>数据来源于亚马逊ABA数据的月度关键词搜索频率排名（Search Frequency Rank）<br>每月月初更新上个月的数据</p>'></span>
                            <br/>排名
                        </div>

            </th>
            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">
                <div class="order-field d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center ">
                    <div class="text-nowrap">
                        <div class="text-nowrap">
                            货流值<span class="fal fa-question-circle ml-1" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                     data-tips='<p></p><p></p><div><div>货流值，反映了关键词的引流成本<br></div><div>计算规则：货流值&nbsp; =&nbsp; 历史最高PPC竞价(短语匹配)/点击排名前3的<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>ASIN的</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>商品价格中位数*100%</span></div><div>一般来说，货流值越小，意味着引流成本越低，竞争越小；同时也可能意味着该词延伸的细分市场还处于蓝海<br></div><div><br></div><div><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>假设</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>关键词yoga mat的货流值为8.3%，关键词bath mat</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>的货流值为7.5%</span></div><div>那么就代表售价同样为10美金的产品，在yoga mat市场<span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>单次</span><span style=&quot;font-size: 1rem;&quot;>需要花费0.83美金的流量成本，在bath mat市场则只需花费0.75美金</span></div><div><br></div><p style=&quot;font-size: 13px;&quot;>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/cn/blog/how-to-understand-traffic-efficiency&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何通过流量成本大小判断市场竞争程度？</a>（图文+视频）</p></div>'></span>
                        </div>

                </div>

                                  data-tips='<p style=&quot;&quot;>关键词在亚马逊站内广告的建议竞价及建议竞价范围（每周更新）</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>默认为【精准匹配】模式下的建议竞价，可以自行切换为【词组匹配】或【广泛匹配】</p><p style=&quot;&quot;><br></p><p style=&quot;&quot;>关键词出价是市场竞争度、市场成熟度的直接反映，也是营销费用的反映</p><p style=&quot;&quot;>在站内广告投放时，您可以优先选择低竞争高需求的关键词，也就是出价较低而搜索量较高的关键词</p>'></span>
                        </div>

                            </div>

                                <option value="phrase">词组</option>
                                <option value="exact">精准</option>
                                <option value="broad">广泛</option>
                            </select>

            <th width="1%" scope="col" class="align-middle">

                        <div>
                            需供比<br/>商品数
                            <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                                  data-tips='<div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;>上行：需供比 = 搜索量(需求) / 商品数(供应)，在同类市场中，需供比值越高，则代表该市场需求越强劲</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;>下行：商品数，指搜索该关键词后出现了多少相关产品(All Departments类目)，比如：1-48 of over 1,000 results for &quot;ipad stand&quot;</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;>（基于IP地址的不同，各地区IP呈现的搜索结果数都不同，所以您在亚马逊前台搜索的结果数可能也会存在差别，<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/v3/knowledge/feature/amazon-search-results&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>详细解释</a>）</div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;><br></div><div class=&quot; old-record-id-doxcn8KgI2WWCqsWyEBc2Vps0Hd&quot;>假设关键词phone holder的月搜索量为69,465，商品数为14,875，则该关键词对应细分市场的需供比为69,465/14,875=4.7</div></div></div>'></span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                        <span class="fal fa-question-circle" data-tips-class="tips-dark"
                              data-tips='<p>数据取自：关键词在亚马逊搜索结果中点击排名前3 ASIN的价格/评分数/评分值“中位数”</p><p>点击数字，可查看该关键词搜索前3页的价格/评分数/评分值分布情况</p><div><br></div><p>价格分布：判断哪个价格区间可能还有机会(价格差异化)，以及哪个价格区间竞争最为激烈</p><p>评分数分布：说明该市场打造新品的难度，如果中低评分数区间占比较大，说明新品进入壁垒不高</p><p>评分值分布：说明该市场的成熟度，如果4.5以上的商品数很多，说明该市场很成熟，通过商品差异性建立竞争壁垒难度较大；如果3.5分商品很多，可能存在改进空间</p><p><br></p><p>扩展阅读：<a href=&quot;https://www.sellersprite.com/v3/knowledge/feature/keyword-analysis&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 156, 0);&quot;>如何通过关键词初步判断细分市场概况？</a></p>'></span>

<script>
    (function () {
        var storageKey = 'closeEPAiGuide';
        var guideTips = document.querySelectorAll('.keyword-ai-guide-tips');
        if (!guideTips.length) return;

        function setGuideVisible(visible) {
            for (var i = 0; i < guideTips.length; i++) {
                guideTips[i].style.display = visible ? 'block' : 'none';
            }
        }

        window.hadLookKeywordResearchGuide = function () {
            window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, true);
            setGuideVisible(false);
        };

        if (window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey)) {
            setGuideVisible(false);
            return;
        }

        setGuideVisible(true);
        window.setTimeout(window.hadLookKeywordResearchGuide, 10000);
    })();
</script>

    <script>
    function getChangePagelink(event){
        changePageTips($(event.target),1)
    }
    function getChangePagelinkSure(){
        let _v = $(event.target).parents(".pager-pages").find(".pager-def-inputs"),val = _v.val();
        if(val != '' && !isNaN(val)){
            changePageTips(_v,2)
        }
    }
    function changePageTips($event,type){
        let maxPage =parseInt($event.attr("max")),isMaxTips = parseInt($event.attr("data-isMax"))||0,
        val = $event.val(),tips="当前数据共"+ maxPage +"页";
        pagination_url =$event.attr("data-url") ,pager_size = $event.attr("data-size");
          if(maxPage < val){
            if(isMaxTips){
                $event.attr('title', tips).attr('data-content', tips).popover('show');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $event.attr('data-content', '')
                }, 800);
            }
            val = maxPage
            $event.val(maxPage)
          }
        if(type == 1){
            if(event.keyCode == 13 && val.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm,'') && !isNaN(val) && maxPage >= val){
                window.location.href=pagination_url+'size='+ pager_size +'&page=' + val.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm,'');
            }
        }else{
            window.location.href=pagination_url+'size='+ pager_size +'&page=' + val.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm,'');
        }
    }

</script>

<script>

            }

                + "' target='_blank'><span class='iconfont icon-export small ml-1'></span></a><br/>"
                + "挖掘该关键词 <a class='no-decoration lighter' href='https://www.sellersprite.com/v3/keyword-miner?marketId=" + marketId + "&q=" + keywords
                + "' target='_blank'><span class='iconfont icon-to_amazon small ml-1'></span></a>";
            $ele.attr('data-tips', tips);
        });
        $('.icon-to-tips').each(tips_popover)
    };

    function flushKeyword(o){
        var $o = $(o), m=$o.attr('data-month'), s = $o.attr('data-station'), k = $o.attr('data-keyword');
        $.getJSON('/v2/base-keyword/flush/' + s + '/' + k + '?t=' + m, function(data) {
            swal({title: '请求已采纳，请稍后查看', text: '大约需要30秒完成数据更新...', type: 'success', showConfirmButton:false, timer:4000})
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        initIconToTips();
    });


    $(".editTranslation").on("click",'.save-btn-event',function () {
        let param = {
            'station':$("input[name='station']").val(),
            'keywords':$(this).parent('.editTranslation').find('.keywords-save').val(),
            'keywordCn':$(this).parent('.editTranslation').find('.keywordCn-val').val()
        };
        $('.save-btn-event').attr('disabled',true);
        let _this = $(this);
        $.ajax({
            type: "post",
            url: "/v2/keyword/updateTranslation",
            data: param,
            cache: false,
            async: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                $('.save-btn-event').attr('disabled',false);
                if (data.error){
                    alert(data.error);
                }else{
                    _this.parents('.edit-translation').find('.span-keywords-transport').text(param.keywordCn);
                    _this.parents('.edit-translation').find('.editTranslation').css("display","none");
                }
            }
        });
    });

    function showEdit(){
        $('.edit-translation').on('click','.edit-btn-event',function(){
            $('.editTranslation').css("display","none");
            $(this).parent('.edit-translation').find('.editTranslation').css("display","inline")
        })
    }
    showEdit()
    // top10
    $('.custom-checkbox').on('click','.checkbox-products-top10',function(){
        let isChecked = $('.custom-checkbox .checkbox-products-top10').prop('checked');
        console.log(isChecked);
        let endIndex = isChecked?9:2;
        $('input[name=itemImageRange]').val(endIndex);
        localStorage.setItem("products-top-ten",endIndex);
        $('#form-condition-search').submit();
    })

    $(function() {
        const ppcSelectedLabelMap = {
            phrase:"词组",
            exact:"精准",
            broad:"广泛",
        }
        // PPC切换匹配模式
        function handlePpcBidMatchTypeChange() {
            $('[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').attr('disabled', true);
            // 保留小数
            function formatDecimal(value) {
                if (!value && value !== 0) {
                    return 'N/A'
                }
                // 例如日本这种小面额货币，就不需要保留小数
                const noDecimalStation = ['JP'].includes($('[ppc-item-station]').val());
                const currency = $('[ppc-item-currency]').val();

                return noDecimalStation ? Number(value).toFixed(0) + '円' : currency + Number(value).toFixed(2)
                // return currency + Number(value).toFixed(noDecimalStation ? 0 : 2)
            }

            const selectedValue = $('[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').val();
            $('.ppc-match .ppc-match-type').text(ppcSelectedLabelMap[selectedValue]);

            $('.ppcBidMatchTypeTd').each(function(idx, td) {
                const ppcItemStr = $(td).find('[ppc-item-obj]').val();
                const ppcItemObj = ppcItemStr.split(',').reduce((acc, ppc) => {const [keyName, value = null] = ppc.split(':');return {...acc, [keyName]: value}}, {});
                let ppcValue = ''

                if (getShowOldPpc()) {
                    $(td).find('[ppc-min]').text(formatDecimal(ppcItemObj['bidMin']));
                    $(td).find('[ppc-max]').text(formatDecimal(ppcItemObj['bidMax']));
                    ppcValue = formatDecimal(ppcItemObj['bid'])
                } else {
                    const selectedValueFirstUpper = selectedValue[0].toUpperCase() + selectedValue.slice(1);
                    $(td).find('[ppc-min]').text(formatDecimal(ppcItemObj['min'+selectedValueFirstUpper+'Ppc']));
                    $(td).find('[ppc-max]').text(formatDecimal(ppcItemObj['max'+selectedValueFirstUpper+'Ppc']));
                    ppcValue = formatDecimal(ppcItemObj[selectedValue+'Ppc'])
                }

                if (ppcValue === 'N/A') {
                    $(td).find('[ppc-value-disabled]').show().text(ppcValue);
                    $(td).find('[ppc-value-clickable]').hide();
                } else {
                    $(td).find('[ppc-value-clickable]').show().text(ppcValue)
                    $(td).find('[ppc-value-disabled]').hide()
                }
            })

            $('[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').attr('disabled', false);
        }

        // ppc竞价 匹配模式
        $('.ppcBidMatchTypeTd').show();
        $('.ppcBidMatchTypeTdOld').hide();

        if (getShowOldPpc()) {
            window.showOldPpc = true;
            $('.ppc-match').hide();
            $('select[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').val('')
        } else {
            window.showOldPpc = false;
            $('.ppc-match').show();

            

            // 事件委托到 document，克隆体触发的 change 也能捕获
            $(document).on('change', '[name="ppcBidMatchType"]', function() {
                // 把所有同名 select（原始+克隆）的值同步成一致
                $('[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').val($(this).val());
                handlePpcBidMatchTypeChange();
            });
            $('[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').val('exact' || 'exact');
        }
        handlePpcBidMatchTypeChange();
    })
  
</script>

<script>
    // 初始化 popover
    function fInitPopover($targets) {
        $targets.each(function (index, ele) {
            var $ele = $(ele);
            $ele.popover({ 'trigger': 'manual', delay: { show: 500 } }).on('mouseenter', function () {
                var _this = this;   // 这里的this触发的dom,需要存起来 否则在下面 .popover的逻辑中this会变为弹出的dom
                $(this).popover("show");
                $(".popover").on("mouseleave", function () {
                    $(_this).popover('hide');
                });
            }).on('mouseleave', function () {
                var _this = this;
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!$(".popover:hover").length) {
                        $(_this).popover("hide");
                    }
                }, 300);
            });
        });
    }
    function reduceTheNumberOfExport($target) {
        //减少导出次数
        try {
            var export_remain_num = $target.attr('export_remain_num');
            if (export_remain_num) {
                var num = parseInt(export_remain_num, 10),
                tips = "您今日的导出次数已使用完，请待明日恢复次数后，再导出";
                if ("com.iyunya.rank.dao.vo.ClientSearchVO@79577899" === "" || ("S" === "G" && "N" !== "Y")){
                    tips = '您是免费用户，<a href="/cn/price" style="border-bottom:1px dashed #FB8C1E" target="_blank">升级套餐</a>后即可导出';
                    num = 1;
                }
                num = num - 1;
                if (num <= 0) {
                    num = 0;
                    $target[0].classList.add('disabled')
                }else{
                    var temp = $target.attr('data-template');
                    if (temp) {
                        tips = temp.replace(/#num#/ig, num);
                    }
                }
                $target.attr('export_remain_num', num);
                $target.attr('data-tips', tips);
                $target.attr('title', tips);
                $target.attr('data-original-title', tips);
                $target.popover('dispose');
                $target.each(tips_popover);
            }
        } catch (error) {

        }
        //减少导出次数
    }

                var sceneTip = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                let content = sceneTip.content;
                let id = sceneTip.id;
                let uri = "'"+ sceneTip.uri + "'";
                let dataTipsContent = '<div class="font-size-12 plr-2">'+ content +'<div class="mt-2 text-right"><a href="javascript:;" onclick="sceneTipsRead('+ id +","+ uri +')" class="i-got-it font-size-12">朕知道了</a></div></div>';
                let sceneTipsUriClass = "." + sceneTip.uri;
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).attr("data-tips",dataTipsContent);
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).each(tips_popover)
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).popover("show");
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).on('hide.bs.popover', function () {
                    $this = $(this);
                    if(content){
                        setTimeout(function () {

                        }, 0);

            let jsonStr = $.trim($('#set_of_scene_tips').html());
            if(jsonStr && "null" != jsonStr){
                let sceneTips = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
                let sceneTip = sceneTips[tipIndex];
                if(!sceneTip) return false
                let content = sceneTip.content;
                let id = sceneTip.id;
                let uri = "'"+ sceneTip.uri + "'";
                let nextTipIndex = tipIndex+1;
                let dataTipsContent = '<div class="font-size-12 plr-2">'+ content +'<div class="mt-2 text-right"><a href="javascript:;" onclick="sceneTipsReadNext('+ id +","+ uri +","+nextTipIndex+')" class="i-got-it font-size-12">朕知道了</a></div></div>';
                let sceneTipsUriClass = "." + sceneTip.uri;
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).attr("data-tips",dataTipsContent);
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).each(tips_popover)
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).popover("show");
                $(sceneTipsUriClass).on('hide.bs.popover', function () {
                    $this = $(this);
                    if(content){
                        setTimeout(function () {
                                $this.popover("show")
                        }, 0);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        handleSetSceneTips()
    // 获取导出次数
    function getRemainExportNum() {
        $("button.remainExportNum-btn").each(function() {
            const $btn = $(this);
            let module = $btn.attr('data-module') || 'NEBD';
            console.log(module, 'module')
            $.ajax({
                type: 'GET',
                url: '/v2/common/remain-export-num/' + module,
                dataType: 'json',
                success: (result) => {
                    if (result.code === 'OK') {
                        let num = result.data * 1 + 1;
                        $btn.attr('export_remain_num', num);
                        reduceTheNumberOfExport($btn);
                    }
                },
                error: (xhr, status, err) => {
                    console.error(module + '剩余次数请求失败:', err);
                }
            });
        });
    }

</script>

<script>
    function fInitFirebaseTopics() {
        const system = "SS_CN".toLowerCase();
        const role = "N".toUpperCase();
        const cqml = "STANDARD".toUpperCase();
        const city = "浙江杭州".toUpperCase();
        if (role === 'R' || role === 'Y') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-admin');
        else if (role === 'SP') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-super-agent');
        else if (role === 'S') window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-sub');
        else window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('Account-parent');

        if (system.indexOf('cn') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-CN');
        else if (system.indexOf('jp') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-JP');
        else if (system.indexOf('en') >= 0) window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push('SS-EN');
        // 推送注册国家
        if (system.indexOf('cn') < 0) city && city.indexOf('|') > 0 && window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push(city.substr(0, 2));

        if (cqml != null && cqml.length > 1) {
            let _ml = "ML-" + cqml;
            window.FIREBASE_TOPICS.push(_ml);
            window.FIREBASE_TOPIC_MEMBER_LEVEL = _ml;
        }
    }fInitFirebaseTopics();
</script>
<script>
    function axisPointerFormatter(params) {
        var value = Number(params.value);
        if (isNaN(value)) {
            return params.value;
        }
        if (value <= 1.0) {
            return value.toFixed(2);
        } else {
            return value.toFixed(0);
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
    function trackClarityEvent(eventName, tags = {}) {
        if(!window.clarity) return

        Object.keys(tags).forEach(key => {
            window.clarity("set", key, String(tags[key]))
        })

        window.clarity("event", eventName)
    }

<script>
    // 显示弹窗
    var currentUri = '/v2/keyword-research';
    // 中文环境
    var isZh = true;
    // 路由命中
    var isMatchedCurrentUri = ['/v2/market-research', '/v2/keyword-research', '/v2/aba/reverse/search'].some(s => s.indexOf(currentUri) > -1);
    // 登录成功
    var isLogin = Number('435722') > 0;
    // 免费会员
    var isFreeMember = 'S' === 'G';

    // 是否是管理员
    var isAdmin = ['Y', 'A2', 'R'].includes('N')

    console.log('路由命中：', isMatchedCurrentUri, ' 是否登录：', isLogin, ' 是否为免费会员（简单判断）：', isFreeMember, ' 是否为管理员：', isAdmin)

    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }

    // 路由命中、且已登录
    if (isLogin && isMatchedCurrentUri) {
        $.ajax({
            url: '/v3/api/popup/push-status',
            method: 'get',
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function (res) {
                // 5分钟拦截
                let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
                let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
                if(!flag) {
                    return;
                }
                // 使用新的判断逻辑
                openDirectionalWechatModal(res);
                return;

                var showWechatDialog = res && (res.data || false)
                if (showWechatDialog) {
                    $.ajax({
                        url: '/v3/api/client/valid-pay-status',
                        method: 'GET',
                        dataType: 'json',
                        success: function(payStatusRes) {
                            $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            // $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden !important' })
                            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                            let isAdmin = false
                            if(isAdmin){
                                $.ajax({
                                    url: '/v2/common/wechat/qr?scene=after_ext_login',
                                    method: 'GET',
                                    dataType: 'json',
                                    success:function(qrData){
                                        // 有效付费用户
                                        if (payStatusRes && payStatusRes.data) {
                                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                                        } else {
                                            $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                            $('[data-free-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                                        }
                                    }
                                })
                            }else{
                                if (payStatusRes && payStatusRes.data) {
                                    $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                                } else {
                                    $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})

                                }
                            }

                           
                        }
                    })
                }
            }
        })
    }

    // 新的打开弹窗逻辑
    function openDirectionalWechatModal(res) {
        if (res) {
            var data = res.data || {};
            var showWechatDialog = data.allowPush === 'Y' && ['Y', 'N'].includes(data.paidUser);

            if (showWechatDialog) {
                $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'flex'})
                // $('body').css({ overflow: 'hidden !important' })
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                $.ajax({
                    url: '/v2/common/wechat/qr?scene=after_ext_login',
                    method: 'GET',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success:function(qrData){
                        // 有效付费用户
                        if (data.paidUser === 'Y') {
                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            $('[data-vip-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                        } else if (data.paidUser === 'N') {
                            $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'flex'})
                            // $('[data-free-member-level]').find(".qrcode-img").attr('src',qrData.data)
                        }
                    }
                })

                        
             
            }
        }
    }

    // 关闭弹窗
    $('[data-directional-wechat-close]').click(function () {
        $('[data-directional-wechat-mask]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('[data-free-member-level]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('[data-vip-member-level]').css({display: 'none'})
        $('body').css({ overflow: '' })
    })
</script>

</style>
<div class="modal fade survey-view-modal" id="surveyViewModal" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" data-backdrop="static"
     data-keyboard="false" aria-labelledby="myModalLabel" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0 auto;overflow:hidden">
    <div class="modal-dialog survey-dialog-modal">
        <input type="hidden" id="surveyId" />
        <input type="hidden" id="answer" />
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header align-items-center">
                <div class="h4 modal-title" id="myModalLabel">
                    问卷调查 - 倾听您的声音，改进您的体验
                </div>
                <button id="btn-modal-close" type="button" class="close"> <span
                        class="iconfont icon-close-icon"></span></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body d-flex justify-content-center scroll-show-auto" id="surveyContent">
            </div>
            <div class="footer-box">
                <button id="submitSurvey" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">
                    <i class="iconfont icon-icon_function_tijiaoshenhe mr-1"></i>我要交卷</button>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    let url="";
    let surveyCodeIn = "";
    let surveyViewModal = $('#surveyViewModal');
    let sType = "";
    function isMobile() {
        var userAgentInfo = navigator.userAgent;
        var mobileAgents = ["Android", "iPhone", "SymbianOS", "Windows Phone", "iPad", "iPod"];
        var mobile_flag = false;
        for (var v = 0; v < mobileAgents.length; v++) {
            if (userAgentInfo.indexOf(mobileAgents[v]) > 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        var screen_width = window.screen.width;
        var screen_height = window.screen.height;
        if (screen_width < 500 && screen_height < 800) {
            mobile_flag = true;
        }
        return mobile_flag;
    }
    var SURVEY_KEY = "SURVEY_KEY_ITEM";
    var item = localStorage.getItem(SURVEY_KEY);
    var lastLoginTime = '1787730717000';
    var surveyed = item != null && item === lastLoginTime;

    // if ('' && !isMobile() && lastLoginTime && !surveyed) {
    //     getSurvey();
    // }
    var timeoutId = null;
    function shouldShowDialog (lastViewTime){
        let currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const fiveMinutes = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        return !lastViewTime || (currentTime - Number(lastViewTime) >= fiveMinutes);
    }
    timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
        let popViewModal = localStorage.getItem('popViewModal');
        let flag = shouldShowDialog(popViewModal)
        if(!flag) return;
        if ('' && !isMobile() && lastLoginTime && !surveyed) {
            getSurvey();
        }
    },1500)
    function getSurvey(surveyCode) {
        surveyCodeIn = surveyCode || '';
        $.ajax({
            type: "get",
            url: "/v2/survey/getSurvey?scope=&language=CN&surveyCode=" + surveyCodeIn,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                if (data && data.code === 1){
                    localStorage.setItem(SURVEY_KEY, lastLoginTime);
                }

                if (data.code === 1 && data.data) {
                    data.data.qaUrl?url=data.data.qaUrl:''
                    var survey = data.data;
                    sType = survey.surveyType;
                    $("#surveyId").val(survey.id);
                    if (survey.surveyType === "C") {//单选题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + ' id="answerItem_' + i + '"  type="radio" class="custom-control-input" >' +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label">' +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value +
                                '</label></div></div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);
                    } else if (survey.surveyType === "P") {// 多选题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle ' + surveyCodeIn + '">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        html += '<div><div id="pcheckbox">'
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div class="custom-control custom-checkbox label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input type="checkbox" name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + '   class="custom-control-input pinput" >'
                                +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label plabel">'
                                +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value
                                +
                                '</label></div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);

                        $(".plabel").on('click', function (e) { //给label添加事件
                            if ($(".pinput").checked) { //由于点击label的时候，还没有告诉checkbo改变状态，所以当前值是false，执行else语句
                                $(".pinput").checked = false //置为false
                            } else {
                                $(".pinput").checked = true //所以这个时候checkbox应该变成了true，状态改变成功！
                            }
                        });
                    }else if (survey.surveyType === "A") {//问答题
                        $("#surveyContent").html('<div class="survey-inputform-box"><div class="surveyTitle text-center">' + survey.title + '</div><div>' +
                            '<input  class="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input" style="margin:0 auto" required type="text" id="inputAnswer" placeholder="在这里输入答案"/>' +
                            '</div></div>')
                    } else if (survey.surveyType === "M") {//复合题
                        if (!survey.content) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var items = JSON.parse(survey.content);
                        var html = '<div class="itemcc-surveys-box">' +
                            '<div class="surveyTitle '+ surveyCodeIn + '">' + survey.title + '</div><div class="content-center">';
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                            html += '<div><div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio label-style-custom">' +
                                '<input name="answerItem"  value=' + items[i].key + ' id="answerItem_' + i + '"  type="radio" class="custom-control-input" >' +
                                '<label for="answerItem_' + i + '" class="custom-control-label">' +
                                items[i].key + ". " + items[i].value +
                                '</label></div>';
                                if(items[i].key == 'O'){
                                    html += '<div style="padding-left:28px"><input  class="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input input_otherReason mb-2" required type="text" id="otherReason" placeholder="在这里输入"/></div>';
                                }
                                if(items[i].key == 'Q'){
                                    let form=document.createElement('form')
                                    form.className="input_otherReason_OO"
                                    form.id="input_otherReason_OO"
                                    let content=items[i].content
                                    for (let index = 0; index < content.length; index++) {
                                        const element = content[index];
                                        if(element.type=="text"){
                                          let div=document.createElement("div")
                                          let input=document.createElement("input")
                                          let label=document.createElement("label")
                                          label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                          input.name=element.label
                                          input.placeholder="请输入"
                                          input.required=element.require
                                          input.className="form-control form-control-sm u-form__input mb-2"
                                          div.append(label)
                                          div.append(input)
                                          form.append(div)
                                        }else if(element.type="option"){
                                            if(element.multiple){
                                                let div=document.createElement("div")
                                                let html=
                                                `<div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                                    <input name="`+element.label+`" value="" `+(element.require?'required':'') +` type="hidden" id="categorys" placeholder="请选择">
                                                    <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                                                    <div class="form-control form-control-sm dimension-type category-custorm-css">
                                                        <span class="lable-category">请选择</span>
                                                        <select disabled class="select-category"></select>
                                                        <div class="category-Objbox">
                                                        <div class="category-box">
                                                       
                                                        </div><div class="mb-1 scroll-show-dimension scroll-show-auto" id="category-box-cotent">`
                                                        for (let j = 0; j < element.options.length; j++) {
                                                            const item = element.options[j];
                                                            html+=`
                                                            <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox mr-2 mb-2" >        
                                                                <input value=`+item+` type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input categoryTypesCheck">     
                                                                <label class="custom-control-label font-12">`+item+`</label>   
                                                            </div>`
                                                        }
                                                        html+=`</div><div class="text-center mt-2">
                                                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pt-1 pb-1 add-category">确定</button>
                                                            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-secondary ml-5 pt-1 pb-1 clear-category">清除</button></div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>`
                                                div.innerHTML=html
                                                let label=document.createElement("label")
                                                label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                                form.append(label)
                                                form.append(div)
                                            }else{
                                                let select=document.createElement("select")
                                                let label=document.createElement("label")
                                                let div=document.createElement("div")
                                                let option=document.createElement("option")
                                                option.textContent="不限"
                                                option.value=""
                                                option.selected=true
                                                select.name=element.label
                                                select.required=element.require
                                                select.placeholder="请选择"
                                                select.className="form-control form-control-sm"
                                                label.innerHTML=element.require?"<span style='color:red'>*</span>"+ element.label:element.label
                                                select.append(option)
                                                div.append(label)
                                                for (let j = 0; j < element.options.length; j++) {
                                                    const item = element.options[j];
                                                    let option=document.createElement("option")
                                                    option.value=item
                                                    option.selected=false
                                                    option.textContent=item
                                                    select.append(option)
                                                }
                                                div.append(select)
                                                form.append(div)
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    setTimeout(() => {
                                        $('.itemcc-surveys-box').append(form)
                                    }, 500);
                                }
                               html += '</div>';
                        }
                        html += '</div></div>';
                        $("#surveyContent").html(html);
                    }
                    surveyViewModal.modal('show');
                    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    // 标记弹窗时间
                    localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                }else{
                    // 无调查问卷返回时如果是取消订阅也应该支持提示
                    canceledSubscriptionModal();
                }
            },
            error: function (data) {
               // 无调查问卷返回时如果是取消订阅也应该支持提示
               canceledSubscriptionModal();
            }
        });
    }
    //选择inputs
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".custom-control-label", function () {
        $(this).parent().find(".custom-control-input").click();
    });
    // 选中其它
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", "input.categoryTypesCheck", function () {
        $(".survey-view-modal").find("#category001").prop("checked", false);
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", "#category001", function () {
        $(".survey-view-modal").find("input.categoryTypesCheck").prop("checked", false);
        return;
    })
        // 确定、清除
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".add-category", function (event) {
        event.stopPropagation()
        clearAddSellerNation($(this), 'add');
    return;

    });
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".clear-category", function () {
        clearAddSellerNation($(this), 'clear');
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", ".category-custorm-css", function (event) {
        event.stopPropagation()
        $(this).addClass('active')
        return;
    })
    $(".survey-view-modal").on("click", function () {
        $('.category-custorm-css').removeClass('active')
        return;
    })
    function clearAddSellerNation($this, type) {
            let value = null;
            let dimensionTypesCheckItem = $("#category-box-cotent").find('input.categoryTypesCheck').filter(':checked');
            if (type == "add") {
                  let itemArr = [];
                  if (dimensionTypesCheckItem.length > 0) {
                        dimensionTypesCheckItem.each(function (i, el) {
                              itemArr.push($(el).val());
                        });
                        value = itemArr.length > 0 ? itemArr.join(',') : null;
                  }
                  if (dimensionTypesCheckItem.length > 0) {
                        $('#categorys').val(value);
                        $('.lable-category').text(value);
                  } else {
                        $('#categorys').val(null);
                        $('.lable-category').text($("#categorys").attr('placeholder'));
                  }
                $('.category-custorm-css').removeClass('active')
            } else if (type == "clear") {
                  value = null;
                  $('#categorys').val(value);
                  $('.lable-category').text($("#categorys").attr('placeholder'));
                  $("#category-box-cotent").find('input.categoryTypesCheck').prop("checked", false);
            }
      }
    $("#submitSurvey").bind('click', function () {
        if (sType == "P") {
            let data_arr = [];
            let check_arr = $('#pcheckbox input[type=checkbox]:checked');
            $.each(check_arr, function () {
                data_arr.push(
                    $(this).val()
                );
            });
            $("#answer").val(data_arr);
        }

        var answer = $("#answer").val();
        if (!answer) {
            alert("您还没有作答哦~");
            return;
        }
        if (answer == 'O') {
            answer = answer + '+' + $("#otherReason").val();
        }
        if(answer=="Q"){
            let form={}
            let validate=true
            $('#input_otherReason_OO :input[required]').each(function(){
                if ($(this).val() === '') {
                validate=false
                alert('请输入必选项')
                return false; 
            }
            if(!validate){
                return
            }
            })
            $('#input_otherReason_OO select[required]').each(function(){
                if ($(this).val() === '') {
                validate=false
                alert('请选择必选项')
                return false; 
            }
            })
            if(!validate){
                return
            }
            let arr=$("#input_otherReason_OO").serializeArray()   
            for (let index = 0; index < arr.length; index++) {
                const element = arr[index];
                form[element.name]=element.value
            }
            answer=answer+"+"+JSON.stringify(form)
        }
        $.ajax({
            type: "post",
            url: "/v2/survey/submitAnswer",
            data: {"id": $("#surveyId").val(), "answer": answer, "surveyType": sType},
            cache: false,
            async: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (data) {
                $('#surveyViewModal').modal('hide');
                // 标记弹窗时间
                localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
                if(url){
                    if (surveyCodeIn != "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL"){
                        swal({
                        title: '提交成功',
                        html: '<div>这次问卷的调查结果随后会发布到“<a class="community-link" href="'+url+'">精灵社区</a>”，</div>想第一时间知道调查结果，就立刻【加入关注】吧~',
                        imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                        imageSize:'70x70',
                        showConfirmButton: true,
                        showCancelButton: true,
                        confirmButtonText: "加入关注",
                        cancelButtonText: "取消",
                        }).then(function(res){
                            if(res.value){
                            $.ajax({
                            type:"put",
                            url: '/bbs/follow-q/'+url.split('/')[url.split('/').length-1],
                            dataType: 'json',
                            contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                            data: JSON.stringify({}),
                            success: function (result) {
                            if(result && result.code == "OK") {
                            }else{
                            createYgtoastError(result.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',6000);
                                }
                            },
                            error: function (error) {
                                createYgtoastError(error.message || '网络错误，请稍后重试！',6000);
                             }
                             })
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }else{
                    if (surveyCodeIn != "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL") {
                        swal({
                            title: '提交成功',
                            html: '<div>非常非常感谢！我们会基于您的反馈不断改进产品<div>期待您的下次配合',
                            imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                            imageSize:'70x70',
                            showConfirmButton: true
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    });

    $("#surveyContent").on("input propertychange", "#inputAnswer", function () {
        $("#answer").val($(this).val());
    });

    $("#surveyContent").on("click", 'input:radio[name="answerItem"]', function () {
        $("#answer").val($(this).val());
        if($(this).val()=="O"){
            $('.input_otherReason').show()
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').hide()
        }else if($(this).val()=="Q"){
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').show()
            $('.input_otherReason').hide()
        }else{
            $('.input_otherReason').hide()
            $('.input_otherReason_OO').hide()
        }
    });
    surveyViewModal.on("click", ".close", function () {
        surveyViewModal.modal('hide');
        $.ajax({
            type: 'post',
            url: '/v2/survey/close-survey',
            data: {
                id: $("#surveyId").val()
            },
            dataType: 'json',
            success: function (obj) {

            },
            error: function () {}
        });
    });
    surveyViewModal.on('hide.bs.modal', function (event) {
        // 标记弹窗时间
        localStorage.setItem('popViewModal',new Date().getTime());
        canceledSubscriptionModal();
    });
    // 无论有无调查问卷都要去继续流程
    function canceledSubscriptionModal(){
        if (surveyCodeIn == "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION_CANCAL") {
            swal({
                title: '取消订阅成功！',
                text: '非常非常感谢！您对卖家精灵的信任与支持，期待与您的下次合作',
                type: 'success',
                showConfirmButton: true
            }).then(function (result) {
                if (result) {
                    window.location.reload()
                }
            });
        }
    }


</script>

<script src="/assets-v2/js/jquery.cookie.js"></script>
<script>
    $(function () {
        var moduleMap = new Map([
            ["/v2/keyword-miner", "keyword-miner"],
            ["/v2/keyword-miner/dynamic", "keyword-miner"],
            ["/v2/keyword-research", "keyword-research"],
            ["/v2/keyword-research-weekly","keyword-research-weekly"],
            ["/v2/keyword-reverse", "keyword-reverse"],
            ["/v2/keyword-checker", "keyword-checker"],
            ["/v2/competitor-lookup", "competitor-lookup"],
            ["/v2/competitor-lookup/monthly", "competitor-lookup"],
            ["/v2/live-search", "live-search"],
            ["/v2/market-research", "market-research"],
            ["/v2/product-research", "product-research"],
        ])

        var selectors = [
            '#form-condition-search .dropdown-item',
            '#form-condition-keyword-earch .dropdown-item',
            '#form-condition-search button[data-market]',
            '#form-condition-search a[data-market-id]',
            '#form-condition-search button[data-market-id]',
           // '#form-condition-search select[name=monthName]',
            '#form-condition-search button[type=submit]',
            '#form-condition-search .monthName-button'
        ]

        $(selectors.join(",")).on('click', function () {
           
            var uri = `/v2/keyword-research`;            
            if (moduleMap.has(uri)) {
                $.cookie("module-station-" + moduleMap.get(uri), $(this).attr('data-market') || $(this).attr('data-market-id'), {
                    path: moduleMap.get(uri) === 'keyword-miner' ? '/v2/keyword-miner' : uri,
                    expires: 365,
                });
                if (uri === '/v2/competitor-lookup' || uri === '/v2/product-research' || uri === '/v2/competitor-lookup/monthly' || uri === '/v2/market-research'){
                    $.cookie("module-table-" + moduleMap.get(uri),
                        $('#form-condition-search').find('select[name=monthName] option:selected').val() || $(this).attr('data-month-id'), {
                        path: uri,
                        expires: 365
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    })

    {{else}}
    {{each(i,vo) customListList}}
    {{if vo.id=="newAdd"}}
    <tr class="new-add-list" data-station="{{= vo.station}}" data-trid="{{= vo.id}}">

    <tr data-trid="{{= vo.id}}" class="category-list-tr" data-station="{{= vo.station}}">
    {{/if}}
        <td class="text-left align-middle">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center pl-0">
                <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox custom-radio custom-label-box">
                    <input name="cateType" value="{{= vo.id}}" ${(i==0 && vo.id!='newAdd')|| (i==0 && vo.id =='newAdd')?'checked':''} type="radio" class="custom-control-input" id="checkbox_{{= vo.id}}">
                    <label for="checkbox_{{= vo.id}}" class="custom-control-label">
                    </label>
                </div>
            </div>
        </td>
        <td class="text-left align-middle">
           <div class="td d-flex align-items-center caname-item">
                {{if vo.id=="newAdd"}}
                <span class="hot-border-dotted" data-id="new"><span class="iconfont icon-label-compile"></span></span>
                {{else}}
                <span class="hot-border-dotted" data-id="{{= vo.id}}">{{= vo.name}}</span>
                {{/if}}
           </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center">
                    ${getStatonName(vo.station)}
            </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center">
                {{= vo.count}}
            </div>
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center">
                ${moment(vo.createdTime).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}
            </div>
