                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary btn-custom-save pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item"  ${(i==0 && vo.id!='newAdd')|| (i==0 && vo.id =='newAdd')?'':'disabled'}><span class="iconfont icon-correct mr-1"></span>保存</button>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}
    {{/if}}
</script>

<script>
    $(function () {
        var Fn = {
            node: {
                $body: $("body"),
                $customCategory: $("#my-custom-category"),
                $categoryBody: $("#category-body"),
                globleStation: 'COM',
                asins: [],
                newListAdd:false,
                usestatic:"M",
                batchName:null,
                staticM:'',
                usesWeekly:null,//周数据标识
            },
            init: function () {
                var that = this;
                that.node.globleStation = "US";
                that.node.usestatic = $("input[name=usestatic]").val();
                that.node.batchName = $("input[name=batchName]")?$("input[name=batchName]").val():null;
                that.node.$customCategory.find(".title-box").text(that.node.usestatic=="M"?that.node.batchName?"加入到关键词清单":"加入到关键词清单-关键词挖掘":"加入到关键词清单-关键词选品");
                that.node.staticM = $("input[name=staticM]").val()?$("input[name=staticM]").val():'';
                that.node.usesWeekly = $("input[name='usesWeekly']").val() || null; 
                that.node.$body.on("click", ".add-asins-btns", function () {
                    Fn.showCateDepPop($(this));
                    return;
                });
                that.node.$customCategory.on("click", ".caname-item", function () {
                    Fn.changeItemName($(this));
                    return false;
                })
                that.node.$customCategory.on("click", ".add-category-btn", function () {
                    Fn.addItemtd($(this));
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$categoryBody.on("change", ".custom-label-box", function () {
                    that.node.$categoryBody.find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled", true);
                    $(this).parents("tr").find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled", false);
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$categoryBody.on("click", ".btn-custom-save", function () {
                    Fn.saveCategoryAll($(this));
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$customCategory.on('click', '.u-modal-window__close', function () {
                    //展示弹窗
                    Fn.hideCatePop();
                    return false;
                });
                that.node.$body.on("change", ".select-all-list", function () {
                    let isTrue = $(this).prop('checked');
                    $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]").prop("checked", isTrue);
                    $("input.select-all-list[type=checkbox]").prop("checked", isTrue);
                    return false;
                });
                $(".table-responsive-md").on("change", "input[data-keyword]", function () {
                    let isTrue = $(this).prop('checked'), boxCklen = $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked").length, boxAlllen = $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]").length;
                    let showAllTrue = false;
                    $(this).prop("checked", isTrue);
                    if (boxCklen < boxAlllen) {
                        showAllTrue = false
                    } else if (boxCklen == boxAlllen) {
                        showAllTrue = true
                    }
                    $("input.select-all-list[type=checkbox]").prop("checked", showAllTrue);
                    return false;
                });
                // that.node.$body.on("click", ".custom-mode-btn", function () {
                //     $(this).addClass("tip-btn-hide");
                //     that.node.$body.find(".category-checkbox-opcity").css("opacity", 1).end().find(".category-checkbox-tip").removeClass("tip-btn-hide");
                //     return false;
                // });
            },
            loadCustomDepList: function () {
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'get',
                    url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/listAll',
                    dataType: 'json',
                    data:{
                        use:Fn.node.usestatic//M=挖掘/R=选品
                    },
                    success: function (result) {
                        let customListList = [];
                        if (result.code == "OK") {
                            customListList = result.data;
                        }
                        Fn.node.$categoryBody.html($("#tpl-category-body").tmpl({ customListList: customListList }));
                    },
                    error: function () {
                        Fn.node.$categoryBody.html($("#tpl-category-body").tmpl({ customListList: [] }));
                    }
                });
            },
            changeItemName: function ($this) {
                let td = $this.find(">span"), id = $this.find(">span").attr("data-id");
                let txt = id == "new" ? td.html() : td.text();
                let input = $("<input type='text' value='' class='item-inputs form-control' maxlength='150' required autocomplete='off'/>");
                id == "new" ? td.find(".icon-label-compile").attr('data-original-title', '').tooltip('hide') : "";
                td.addClass("transparent-bottom-color").html(input)
                input.click(function () { return false; });
                //获取焦点
                input.trigger("focus").val(id == "new" ? "" : txt);
                //文本框失去焦点后提交内容，重新变为文本
                input.blur(function () {Fn.blurKeydownInput($(this),td,txt,id)});
                input.bind('keypress',function(event){
                    if(event.keyCode == "13")    
                    {
                        Fn.blurKeydownInput($(this),td,txt,id)
                    }
                });   
            },
            blurKeydownInput: function($this,td,txt,id){
                    let newtxt = $.trim($this.val());
                    let $inputs = $this;
                    //判断文本有没有修改
                    if (newtxt != txt && newtxt != "") {
                        let dataNewTxt = { name: newtxt,use:Fn.node.usestatic}
                        // if(that.node.usesWeekly){
                        //     dataNewTxt.weekly = 'Y'
                        // }
                        if (id == "new") {
                            dataNewTxt.station = Fn.node.globleStation;
                            $.ajax({
                                type: 'post',
                                url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/add',
                                data: dataNewTxt, //M=挖掘/R=选品 
                                dataType: 'json',
                                success: function (result) {
                                    Fn.disposeDepartment(result, td, $inputs, txt);
                                },
                                error: function (e) {
                                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message})
                                }
                            });
                        } else {
                            dataNewTxt.station = id;
                            dataNewTxt.id = id;
                            $.ajax({
                                type: 'post',
                                url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/edit',
                                data: dataNewTxt, //M=挖掘/R=选品 
                                dataType: 'json',
                                success: function (result) {
                                    Fn.disposeDepartment(result, td, $inputs, txt);
                                },
                                error: function (e) {
                                     Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message})
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        td.removeClass("transparent-bottom-color").html(txt);
                    }
                
            },
            //处理数据
            disposeDepartment: function (result, $td, $inputs, txt) {
                if (result.code == "OK") {
                    if (result.data) {
                        $td.attr("data-id", result.data);
                        $td.parents("tr").addClass("category-list-tr").attr("data-trid", result.data).removeClass("new-add-list");
                    }
                    $td.removeClass("transparent-bottom-color").html($inputs.val());
                    if(Fn.node.newListAdd){Fn.saveCategoryAll($td.parents("tr").find(".btn-custom-save"))}
                } else {
                    $inputs.attr('title', '').attr('data-original-title', result.message).tooltip('show').trigger("focus");
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        $inputs.tooltip('hide')
                    }, 3000);
                    if($(".btn-custom-save:not(:disabled)").length==0){$td.parents("tr").find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled", false)}
                    Fn.node.newListAdd=false;
                }

            },
            addItemtd: function () {
                let listId = $("tr.new-add-list"), nodataList = $("#category-body tr.nodata-tr"), allList = $("#category-body tr.category-list-tr");
                let nowDate = new Date();
                let isloadingTr = $("#category-body tr.no-data-loading");
                isloadingTr.length>0?isloadingTr.remove():"";
                if (listId.length == 0) {
                    nodataList.length > 0 ? nodataList.remove() : Fn.node.$categoryBody.find(".btn-custom-save").prop("disabled",true);
                    Fn.node.$categoryBody.prepend($("#tpl-category-body").tmpl({ customListList: [{ id: "newAdd", trnew: listId, count: 0, station: Fn.node.globleStation, createdTime: nowDate, allList: allList.length }] }))
                    Fn.node.$categoryBody.find(".new-add-list .caname-item").trigger("click");
                } else {
                    Fn.showInputsTips("您还没有填写/保存清单名称！")
                }

            },
            showInputsTips: function (message) {
                $("tr.new-add-list .icon-label-compile").attr('title', '').attr('data-original-title', message).tooltip('show');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    $("tr.new-add-list .icon-label-compile").attr('data-original-title', '').tooltip('hide');
                }, 2000);
            },
            saveCategoryAll: function ($this) {
                let listId = $this.parents("tr").attr("data-trid"),that = this, itemStation = $this.parents("tr").attr("data-station");
                if (itemStation != "US") {
                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: "注意清单列表的站点必须与关键词清单站点一致！" });
                    return;
                }
                if(listId==""){return}
                if ((listId != ""&&listId == "newAdd")) {
                    if($this.parents("tr").find(".icon-label-compile").length==0){
                        Fn.node.newListAdd =true;
                    }else{
                        Fn.showInputsTips("您还没有填写/保存清单名称！")
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if($this.parents("tr").find(".item-inputs").length!=0){Fn.node.newListAdd
                return;}
                $this.prop("disabled", true);
                let addKeywordsData = {
                        id: listId,
                        station: itemStation,
                        keywords: Fn.node.asins
                    }
                if(that.node.usesWeekly){
                    addKeywordsData.weekly = 'Y'
                }
                $.ajax({
                    type: 'post',
                    url: '/v2/keyword-inventory/addKeywords',
                    data: addKeywordsData,
                    dataType: 'json',
                    success: function (result) {
                        $this.prop("disabled", false);
                        Fn.node.newListAdd=false;
                        if (result.code == "OK") {
                            Fn.hideCatePop();
                            Swal.fire({
                                title: '添加成功！', //标题
                                html: '<span style="color: #66BC38"> '+(that.node.usestatic=="M"?"关键词清单入口在关键词挖掘右上角，是否立即去查看？": "已成功加入“关键词选品清单”，是否立即查看呢？")+'</span>',
                                textColor: '#66BC38',
                                imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-successful.png',
                                imageSize: '70x70',
                                confirmButtonColor: '#FB8C1E',
                                confirmButtonText: '立即查看',
                                showCancelButton: true,
                                cancelButtonColor: '#CFD2D6',
                                cancelButtonText: "关闭窗口",
                                focusCancel: true,
                            }).then((isConfirm) => {
                                try {
                                    //判断 是否 点击的 确定按钮
                                    if (isConfirm.value) {
                                        window.open('/v2/keyword-inventory/list?type='+Fn.node.usestatic)
                                    }
                                    else {
                                        window.location.reload(true);
                                    }
                                } catch (e) {
                                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e, imageUrl: "" })
                                }
                            });
                        }

                    },
                    error: function (e) {
                        $this.prop("disabled", false);
                        Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: e.message, imageUrl: "" })
                    }
                });
            },
            showCateDepPop: function ($this) {
                $this.prop("disabled", true);
                let _$asinList = $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked");
                let loading = '<tr class="no-data-loading"><td colspan="6"><div class="pt-4 text-center"><img src="/assets/images/admin-loading.gif" alt="" width="32"></div></td></tr>'
                Fn.node.asins = [];
                Fn.node.$categoryBody.html(loading)
                if (_$asinList.length > 0) _$asinList.each(function () {
                    // console.log($(this));
                    if(!$(this)[0].disabled){
                        let keyword = $(this).attr('data-keyword');
                        keyword?Fn.node.asins.push(keyword) : null; 
                    }
                });
                if (Fn.node.asins.length < 1) {
                    Fn.showTipPop({ title: "", text: "请选择您想要加入关键词清单的列表！" })
                } else {
                    Fn.loadCustomDepList();
                    Fn.node.$customCategory.modal();
                }
                $this.prop("disabled", false);

            },
            showTipPop: function (params) {
                swal({
                    title: params.title ? params.title : '温馨提示',
                    text: params.text?params.text:'主人，请求太过频繁，网络不稳定，请稍后重试！',
                    imageUrl: params.imageUrl ? params.imageUrl : '../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
                    imageSize: '70x70',
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                });
            },
            hideCatePop: function () {
                Fn.node.$customCategory.modal('hide');
            },

        }
        Fn.init();
    });
    function getStatonName(code) {
        let stationList = JSON.parse('[{"country":"United States","website":"https://www.amazon.com","code":"COM","marketplace":"ATVPDKIKX0DER","areas":["US","MX"],"publicCode":"US","label":"美国站(com)","shortname":"美","marketId":1,"countryCode":"US","online":true,"currency":"$","currencyCode":"USD"},{"country":"Japan","website":"https://www.amazon.co.jp","code":"JP","marketplace":"A1VC38T7YXB528","areas":["JP"],"publicCode":"JP","label":"日本站(co.jp)","shortname":"日","marketId":6,"countryCode":"JP","online":true,"currency":"円","currencyCode":"JPY"},{"country":"United Kingdom","website":"https://www.amazon.co.uk","code":"UK","marketplace":"A1F83G8C2ARO7P","areas":["GB"],"publicCode":"UK","label":"英国站(co.uk)","shortname":"英","marketId":3,"countryCode":"GB","online":true,"currency":"£","currencyCode":"GBP"},{"country":"Germany","website":"https://www.amazon.de","code":"DE","marketplace":"A1PA6795UKMFR9","areas":["DE"],"publicCode":"DE","label":"德国站(de)","shortname":"德","marketId":4,"countryCode":"DE","online":true,"currency":"€","currencyCode":"EUR"},{"country":"France","website":"https://www.amazon.fr","code":"FR","marketplace":"A13V1IB3VIYZZH","areas":["FR"],"publicCode":"FR","label":"法国站(fr)","shortname":"法","marketId":5,"countryCode":"FR","online":true,"currency":"€","currencyCode":"EUR"},{"country":"Italy","website":"https://www.amazon.it","code":"IT","marketplace":"APJ6JRA9NG5V4","areas":["IT"],"publicCode":"IT","label":"意大利(it)","shortname":"意","marketId":35691,"countryCode":"IT","online":true,"currency":"€","currencyCode":"EUR"},{"country":"Spain","website":"https://www.amazon.es","code":"ES","marketplace":"A1RKKUPIHCS9HS","areas":["ES"],"publicCode":"ES","label":"西班牙(es)","shortname":"西","marketId":44551,"countryCode":"ES","online":true,"currency":"€","currencyCode":"EUR"},{"country":"Canada","website":"https://www.amazon.ca","code":"CA","marketplace":"A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2","areas":["CA"],"publicCode":"CA","label":"加拿大(ca)","shortname":"加","marketId":7,"countryCode":"CA","online":true,"currency":"CDN$","currencyCode":"CAD"},{"country":"India","website":"https://www.amazon.in","code":"IN","marketplace":"A21TJRUUN4KGV","areas":["IN"],"publicCode":"IN","label":"印度站(in)","shortname":"印","marketId":44571,"countryCode":"IN","online":true,"currency":"₹","currencyCode":"INR"},{"country":"Mexico","website":"https://www.amazon.com.mx","code":"MX","marketplace":"A1AM78C64UM0Y8","areas":["MX"],"publicCode":"MX","label":"墨西哥(mx)","shortname":"墨","marketId":771770,"countryCode":"MX","online":true,"currency":"MX$","currencyCode":"MXN"},{"country":"Brazil","website":"https://www.amazon.com.br","code":"BR","marketplace":"A2Q3Y263D00KWC","areas":["BR"],"publicCode":"BR","label":"巴西站(br)","shortname":"巴","marketId":15,"countryCode":"BR","online":false,"currency":"R$","currencyCode":"BRL"},{"country":"Australia","website":"https://www.amazon.com.au","code":"AU","marketplace":"A39IBJ37TRP1C6","areas":["AU"],"publicCode":"AU","label":"澳大利亚(au)","shortname":"澳","marketId":111172,"countryCode":"AU","online":false,"currency":"A$","currencyCode":"AUD"},{"country":"United Arab Emirates","website":"https://www.amazon.ae","code":"AE","marketplace":"A2VIGQ35RCS4UG","areas":["AE"],"publicCode":"AE","label":"阿联酋(ae)","shortname":"阿","marketId":9,"countryCode":"AE","online":false,"currency":"د.إ","currencyCode":"AED"},{"country":"Saudi Arabia","website":"https://www.amazon.sa","code":"SA","marketplace":"A17E79C6D8DWNP","areas":["SA"],"publicCode":"SA","label":"沙特站(sa)","shortname":"沙","marketId":13,"countryCode":"SA","online":false,"currency":"S.R","currencyCode":"SAR"}]'), stationName = "";
        $.each(stationList, function (i, item) {
            if (code == item.publicCode) {
                stationName = item.label;
                return false
            }
        });
        return stationName.split("(")[0]

    }
</script><aside id="product_edit" class="u-sidebar u-unfold--css-animation u-unfold--hidden">

<script id="template-markets-tables-departments" type="text/template">
    <div class="row mt-4">
        {{if items && items.length >0}}
            <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
                {{each(index,item) items}}
                {{if index < (items.length/2)}}
                        <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox mt-2">
                            {{if item.checked && item.checked != 'false' }}
                                <input type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" name="departments[{{= index+1}}]" value="{{= item.code}}" id="checkbox{{= index}}"  checked>
                            {{else}}
                            <input type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" name="departments[{{= index+1}}]" value="{{= item.code}}" id="checkbox{{= index}}">
                            {{/if}}
                            <label for="checkbox{{= index}}" class="custom-control-label">
                                {{= item.label}}
                            </label>
                        </div>
                {{/if}}
                {{/each}}
            </div>

            <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
                {{each(index,item) items}}
                {{if index >= (items.length/2)}}
                    <div class="custom-control custom-checkbox mt-2">
                        {{if item.checked && item.checked != 'false' }}
                        <input type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" name="departments[{{= index+1}}]" value="{{= item.code}}" id="checkbox{{= index}}"  checked>
                        {{else}}
                        <input type="checkbox" class="custom-control-input" name="departments[{{= index+1}}]" value="{{= item.code}}" id="checkbox{{= index}}">
                        {{/if}}
                        <label for="checkbox{{= index}}" class="custom-control-label">
                            {{= item.label}}
                        </label>
                    </div>
                {{/if}}
                {{/each}}
            </div>
        {{/if}}
    </div>
</script>
<script id="querylog-tbody-noitem-tmp" type="text/template">
    <tr>
        <td colspan="4" style="border-bottom: none;">
            <div class="align-center text-muted" style="text-align: center;min-height:250px;padding-top: 100px;" >
                <div class="align-center querylog-div-noitems">暂无查询记录！</div>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
</script>
<script id="querylog-tbody-loading" type="text/template">
    <tr>
        <td colspan="4" style="border-bottom: none;">
            <div class="align-center text-muted" style="text-align: center;min-height:250px;padding-top: 100px;" >
                <div class="align-center querylog-div-noitems">加载中......</div>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
  </script>
<script id="querylog-tbody-tmp" type="text/template">
    {{each(index,item) pg.items}}
    <tr style="line-height: normal;display:flex;border-bottom: 1px solid #eff1f4;" class="align-items-center justify-content-between">

        <td class="align-middle align-middle-1">
            <div class="d-flex align-items-top ml-4">
                <span class="flag-icon flag-icon-${item.market.countryCode.toLowerCase()} mr-3"></span>

                <a href="{{= item.url}}"  class="link-dark link-title" style="border-bottom: none;line-height: 1.2rem;" >
                    {{if item.asinObj && item.asinObj.title}}
                         <div class="ellipsis" title="{{= item.asinObj.title}}" style="text-overflow: inherit;" >
                             {{= item.asinObj.title}}
                        </div>
                    {{else item.keywords}}
                    <span class="w150 break-all">{{= item.keywords}}</span>
                    {{else}}
                  <div class="ellipsis" title="默认查询" style="text-overflow: inherit;" >
                    默认查询
                  </div>
                  {{/if}}
                </a>
            </div>
    </td>
        <!-- <td class="align-middle align-middle-1">

        </td> -->
        <td class="align-middle align-middle-1 text-center">
            {{if item.free == 'Y' }}
            <div class="td text-31C993" style="text-decoration: underline;" data-tips="查询结果未完整展示" >{{= item.results}}</div>
            {{else}}
            <div class="td text-31C993">{{= item.results}}</div>
            {{/if}}
        </td>
        <td class="align-middle align-middle-1 text-center mr-4 ml-7">
            <div class="mw80">${moment(item.queryTime).format('YYYY-MM-DD')}</div>
  </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}
  </script>
  <script id="querylog-pg-nv-tmp" type="text/template">
    <div class="col-12 col-md-12">
        <div class="row no-gutters align-items-baseline">
            <div class="col-12 col-md-auto flex-grow-0 text-center text-md-left">
                <span class="text-secondary text-nowrap ml-4">
                    {{if pg.items && pg.items.length < pg.pageSize}}
                        <span class="text-primary">${pg.startIndex + 1}-{{= pg.startIndex + pg.items.length}}</span>
                    {{else}}
                        <span class="text-primary">${pg.startIndex + 1}-{{= pg.startIndex + pg.pageSize}}</span>
                    {{/if}}
                    /{{if pg.totalCount && pg.totalCount >= 1000}} 1000+ {{else}} {{= pg.totalCount}} {{/if}}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div class="col-12 col-md-auto mt-3 mt-md-0">
                <ul class="pagination m-0 ml-2 justify-content-center justify-content-md-start">
                    
                    {{each(index,page) pg.pages}}
                    {{if index < 5 }}
                    <li class="page-item {{if page == pg.currentPage}}active{{/if}}" data-page="{{= page}}" ><a class="page-link" href="javascript:;">{{= page}}</a></li>
                    {{/if}}
                    {{/each}}
                    </ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</script>

<script>
    //------------------ASIN 价格趋势图-------------------------------
    var priceTrendChart;
    function initpriceTrendChart(chartId) {
        Customer.showChartLoading(priceTrendChart, chartId);
        if (priceTrendChart) priceTrendChart.dispose();
        priceTrendChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('container-trend-price-chart'), 'light');
        // 指定图表的配置项和数据
        var option = {
            title: {
                text: ''
            },
            color: ['#FFAE2D', '#6EC952', '#5FB0FF'],
            tooltip: {
                trigger: 'axis',
                axisPointer: {
                    type: 'cross',
                    label: {
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, .7)',
                       formatter: axisPointerFormatter
                    }
                },
                padding: [15, 15],
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, .7)',
                formatter: function (params) {
                    if(params.length >1){
                        return getTooltipHtml([{
                        key: '产品数量',
                        value: params[0].value,
                        color: params[0].color
                    }, {
                        key: '数量占比',
                        value: params[1].value == 0 ? '0%' : (params[1].value * 100).toFixed(0) + '%',
                        color: params[1].color
                    }]
                    );
                    }else{
                        return getTooltipHtml([{
                        key: params[0].seriesName,
                        value: params[0].value,
                        color: params[0].color
                    }]
                    );
                    }
                    // return getTooltipHtml([{
                    //     key: '产品数量',
                    //     value: params[0].value,
                    //     color: params[0].color
                    // }, {
                    //     key: '数量占比',
                    //     value: params[1].value == 0 ? '0%' : (params[1].value * 100).toFixed(0) + '%',
                    //     color: params[1].color
                    // }]
                    // );
                }
            },
            legend: {
                textStyle: {
                    color: '#505355'
                },
                formatter: function (name) {
                    if (name == '数量') {
                        return '产品数量'
                    } else {
                        return name
                    }
                }
            },
            grid: {
                top: '16%',
                left: '3%',
                right: '3%',
                bottom: '12%',
                containLabel: true
            },
            xAxis: [
                {
                    type: 'category',
                    axisLine: {
                        onZero: true,
                        lineStyle: {
                            color: '#DEE1E7'
                        }
                    },
                    axisLabel: {
                        interval: 0,
                        color: '#656C72',
                    },
                    axisPointer: {
                        type: 'shadow'
                    },
                    data: []
                }
            ],
            yAxis: [
                {
                    type: 'value',
                    name: '数量',
                    nameTextStyle: {
                        color: '#656C72'
                    },
                    axisLine: {
                        lineStyle: {

    //-------------------Echarts 自适应---------------------------
    var charts = [];
    function addChartInstance(chart) {
        var needAdd = true;
        for (var i = 0; i < charts.length; i++) {
            var dchart = charts[i];
            if (chart.id == dchart.id) {
                needAdd = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (needAdd) charts.push(chart);
    };
    function resizeCharts() {
        for (var i = 0; i < charts.length; i++) {
            var chart = charts[i];
            if (chart && chart['id'] && chart['resize']) {
                try {
                    chart.resize();
                } catch (err) {

                }
            }
        }
    };
    var makertTimeout = null;
    $(document).ready(function () {
        //window 大小重置
        $(window).resize(function () {
            if (makertTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(marketTimeout);
            }
            marketTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
                resizeCharts();
            }, 100);
        });
        //window 大小重置
    });
    var getTooltipHtml = function (data) {
        var _html = '<table class="market-tooltip market-tooltip-small" frame="void">';
        data.forEach(function (item) {
            var div = '<div class="my-tooltip market-tooltip-small">' +
                '<div>' +
                '<div class="my-tooltip-mark1" style="background-color:' + item.color + ' "></div>' +
                '<span>' + item.key + '</span>' +
                '<span class="my-tooltip-value">' + item.value + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</div>';
            _html +=
                '    <tr>' +
                '        <td>' + div + '</td>'
            '    </tr>';
        });
        _html += '</table>';
        return _html;
    };
    //  处理数据
    var asinDatasListAll = {}, asinDatasList = [];
    var dataProcessing = function (paramsObj) {
    var FlagDy=window.location.pathname.indexOf("keyword-miner/dynamic")//关键词动态挖掘
    var FlagSt=window.location.pathname.indexOf("keyword-miner")//静态
    var FlagRs=window.location.pathname.indexOf("keyword-research")//关键词选品
        if(FlagSt != -1 && FlagDy == -1){
                var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month+'&parentModule=KM&dynamic='+false;
            }else if(FlagSt != -1 && FlagDy != -1){//动态
                var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month+'&parentModule=KM&dynamic='+true;
            }
            // else if(FlagRs != -1){
            //     var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month+'&parentModule=KR';

            // }
            else{
                var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month ;
            }
        
        $.getJSON(reqUrl, function (result) {
            paramsObj.callback(result, paramsObj.popType);
        });
    }
    function callbackItem(result, popType) {
       asinDatasList = result
        asinDatasListAll = {
            price: [],
            review: [],
            rating: [],
            totalLength: asinDatasList.length,
            pricexAxis: [],
            reviewAxis: ['无评分数', '1-50', '50-100', '100-200', '200-300', '300-500', '500以上'],
            ratingxAxis: ['2.0以下', '2.0-3.0', '3.0-3.5', '3.5-4.0', '4.0-4.3', '4.3-4.5', '4.5以上'],
        }
        let priceArray = [];
        $.each(asinDatasListAll.reviewAxis, function (index, item) {
            asinDatasListAll.review.push({
                value: 0,
                data: []
            });
            if (index < asinDatasListAll.ratingxAxis.length) {
                asinDatasListAll.rating.push({
                    value: 0,
                    data: []
                });
            }
        })
        $.each(asinDatasList, function (index, item) {
            //价格区间
            //评分区间 asinRating
            let itemRating = item.asinRating?(item.asinRating * 10).toFixed(0):0, ratingIndex = -1;
            if (itemRating < 20) {
                ratingIndex = 0
            } else if (20 <= itemRating && itemRating < 30) {
                ratingIndex = 1
            } else if (30 <= itemRating && itemRating < 35) {
                ratingIndex = 2
            } else if (35 <= itemRating && itemRating < 40) {
                ratingIndex = 3
            } else if (40 <= itemRating && itemRating < 43) {
                ratingIndex = 4
            } else if (43 <= itemRating && itemRating < 45) {
                ratingIndex = 5
            } else if (45 <= itemRating) {
                ratingIndex = 6
            }
            // //评论数区间  asinReviews
            let itemReviews = item.asinReviews?item.asinReviews:0, reviewsIndex = -1;
            if (itemReviews <= 0) {
                reviewsIndex = 0
            } else if (1 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 50) {
                reviewsIndex = 1
            } else if (50 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 100) {
                reviewsIndex = 2
            } else if (100 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 200) {
                reviewsIndex = 3
            } else if (200 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 300) {
                reviewsIndex = 4
            } else if (300 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 500) {
                reviewsIndex = 5
            } else if (500 <= itemReviews) {
                reviewsIndex = 6
            }
            item.asinPrice=item.asinPrice?item.asinPrice:0;
            priceArray.push(item.asinPrice);
            if (reviewsIndex >= 0) {
                asinDatasListAll.review[reviewsIndex].data.push(item);
                asinDatasListAll.review[reviewsIndex].value += 1;
            }
            if (ratingIndex >= 0) {
                asinDatasListAll.rating[ratingIndex].data.push(item);
                asinDatasListAll.rating[ratingIndex].value += 1;
            }
        });
        asinDatasListAll.price = Customer.calcPriceChartStepSize(priceArray);
        $.each(asinDatasListAll.price, function (index, item) {
            let len = asinDatasListAll.price.length, keyValue = "";
            if (index < len - 1) {
                keyValue = item.key + '-' + asinDatasListAll.price[index + 1].key
            } else {
                keyValue = item.key + '以上'
            }
            asinDatasListAll.pricexAxis.push(keyValue);
        })
        Customer.closeChartLoading(priceTrendChart)
        Customer.closeChartLoading(reviewTrendChart)
        Customer.closeChartLoading(ratingTrendChart)
        addSeries(popType)
    }
    function addSeries(popType) {
        if (asinDatasList.length == 0) {
            priceTrendChart.hideLoading();
            reviewTrendChart.hideLoading();
            ratingTrendChart.hideLoading();
            $(".prompt-empty").show()
            return;
        }else{
            $(".prompt-empty").hide()
        }
        switch (popType) {
            case 'price':
                priceTrendChart.setOption({
                    legend: {
                        formatter: function (name) {
                            if (name == '数量') {
                                return '产品数量(' + asinDatasListAll.totalLength + ')'
                            } else {
                                return name
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    xAxis: {
                        data: asinDatasListAll.pricexAxis
                    },
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '数量占比',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.price.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: ((item.value / asinDatasListAll.totalLength)).toFixed(2)
                                };
                            })
                        },
                        {
                            name: '数量',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.price.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: item.value,
                                };
                            })
                        },

                    ]
                });
                break;
            case 'reviews':
                reviewTrendChart.setOption({
                    legend: {
                        formatter: function (name) {
                            if (name == '数量') {
                                return '产品数量(' + asinDatasListAll.totalLength + ')'
                            } else {
                                return name
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    xAxis: {
                        data: asinDatasListAll.reviewAxis
                    },
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '数量占比',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.review.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: ((item.value / asinDatasListAll.totalLength)).toFixed(2)
                                };
                            })
                        },
                        {
                            name: '数量',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.review.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: item.value,
                                };
                            })
                        },

                    ]
                });
                break;
            case 'rating':
                ratingTrendChart.setOption({
                    legend: {
                        formatter: function (name) {
                            if (name == '数量') {
                                return '产品数量(' + asinDatasListAll.totalLength + ')'
                            } else {
                                return name
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    xAxis: {
                        data: asinDatasListAll.ratingxAxis
                    },
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '数量占比',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.rating.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: ((item.value / asinDatasListAll.totalLength)).toFixed(2)
                                };
                            })
                        },
                        {
                            name: '数量',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.rating.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: item.value,
                                };
                            })
                        },

                    ]
                });
                break;
        }


    }
    //-------------------Echarts 自适应---------------------------
    //-------------------图表渲染---------------------------
    //-------------------公共常量------------------------
    var showFormat = 'YYYY-MM-DD';
    //-------------------公共常量------------------------

    //-------------------图表渲染---------------------------
    $(document).ready(function () {
        $(".second-nav-js-scrollbar").mCustomScrollbar({axis:"x", theme:"minimal-dark",autoHideScrollbar: true,});
        $.ajax({
            url:"/v2/keyword-stat/gk/month",
            method:"get",
            dataType:"json",
            success:function(data){
                if (data && JSON.stringify(data) != "{}") {
                    data.forEach(function (item, index) {
                        // GK数据后台只保存了近5个月的数据，5个月以前的均没有数据
                        // https://etdxr3a3ez.feishu.cn/record/D69Sr89zveV3slcod3hc4XUFnpf?ccm_open_type=im_card_automation_button
                        if (index > 4) {
                            return;
                        }
                        let li = document.createElement("li")
                        let ul = $(".second-nav")
                        li.className = "second-nav-item"
                        li.dataset.value = item
                        index == 0 ? li.classList.add("second-nav-item-active") : ''
                        li.textContent = item.substr(0, 4) + "/" + item.substr(4)
                        li.onclick = function () {
                            $(this).addClass("second-nav-item-active").siblings().removeClass("second-nav-item-active");
                            $(".nav-item[pop-type='market']").find(".nav-link").click()
                        }
                        ul.append(li)
                    })
                }

            }
        })
        //----------------弹窗 tab 切换----------------------
        $('#modal-nav').on("click", '.nav-item', function () {
            let modalId = 'keywords-monopoly-trends', $modal = $('#' + modalId), popType = $(this).attr('pop-type');;
            //切换modal nav
            if (popType) modalNavSwitch($modal, popType);
        })
        //----------------弹窗 tab 切换----------------------
        //----------------弹窗 显示----------------------
        $("body").on('click','.pop-ele', function () {
            //展示弹窗
            let modalId = 'keywords-monopoly-trends', $modal = $('#' + modalId), that = $(this), popType = that.attr('pop-type'), nrs = that.attr('data-key'),
            website = that.attr('data-station-website');
            //切换modal nav
            let midNode=$(this).closest('tr').find(".show-monopoly-trends")
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.station = midNode.attr("data-countryCode");
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.station =midNode.attr("data-station");
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.currency =midNode.attr("data-currency")||"$";
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.keyword =midNode.attr("data-keyword");
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.gv = (midNode.attr("data-gv") == "true") ? true : false;
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.marketKey= midNode.closest('tr').find(".pop-ele").attr('data-key')
            $('[data-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip("hide");
            Customer.showSelfModal(modalId, '95%');
            setTimeout(function () {
                window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.changeActiveItem("market",popType)
                $(".monopoly-flag-link").find(".flag-icon").addClass("flag-icon-" +  window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.station.toLowerCase()).end()
                        .find(".keywords-text").text(window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.keyword).end();
                        $('[data-tips]').each(tips_popover);
                // 去亚马逊搜索结果页
                $(".link-amazon-listing").attr('href',website+"/s??k="+nrs);
            }, 0);
            return;
        });
        //-------------------弹窗事件---------------------------
        var asinDatasList = {};
        function modalNavSwitch($modal, popType, nowall, nrs) {
            $modal.find('.maket-modal-body>div[id^="container-trend-"]').hide().end().find(".maket-nav-link").removeClass('active').end().find('.maket-nav-link.container-trend-' + popType).addClass('active');
            $modal.find('#container-trend-bsr').show().end().find('.market-modal-chart').hide().end().find('#container-trend-' + popType + '-chart').show();
            //
            //处理时间跨度及图表类型按钮
            if (nowall) {
                loadBsrTrendData(popType, nrs);
            } else {
                addSeries(popType)
            }

            resizeCharts();
        };

        //-------------------数据加载------------------------
        //--------------加载自有 ASIN 趋势数据-------------------------
        function loadBsrTrendData(popType, nrs) {
            let month=$(".second-nav").find(".second-nav-item-active").attr("data-value")
            if(nrs){
                $(".prompt-empty").hide()
            }else{
                $(".prompt-empty").show()
            }
            let condition = $("#form-condition-search");
            // //展示加载中
            if(nrs){
                initpriceTrendChart('container-trend-price-chart');
                initreviewTrendChart('container-trend-reviews-chart');
                initratingTrendChart('container-trend-rating-chart');
                dataProcessing({
                'callback': callbackItem,
                'station': condition.find("input[name=station]").val(),
                'keyword': nrs,
                'popType': popType,
                'month':month,
            });
            }
        };

    .keyword-trends-ai-button .ai-expand-product-btn{
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 82px;
        height: 32px;
        padding: 0;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: linear-gradient(#fff, #fff) padding-box, linear-gradient(90deg, #4c57e6, #e94e80, #ff870c) border-box;
        line-height: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .ai-expand-product-btn:hover{
        background: linear-gradient(#fff, #fff) padding-box, linear-gradient(90deg, #4c57e6, #e94e80, #ff870c) border-box;
        text-decoration: none;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .ai-expand-product-btn[disabled]{
        opacity: .65;
        cursor: not-allowed;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .ai-expand-product-btn img{
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        margin-right: 3px;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .ai-expand-product-text{
        color: transparent;
        background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #4c57e6, #e94e80, #ff870c);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        background-clip: text;
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 600;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .loading-container{
        display: none;
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        margin-right: 4px;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .radiating-spinner{
        --spinner-base-size: 14px;
        --spoke-base-length: 4px;
        --spoke-base-offset: 5px;
        position: relative;
        width: var(--spinner-base-size);
        height: var(--spinner-base-size);
        animation: spin-container 1.2s linear infinite;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke{
        position: absolute;
        width: var(--spoke-base-length);
        height: 1px;
        background-color: currentColor;
        border-radius: 1px;
        left: 50%;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(var(--spoke-base-offset));
        color: #4557EA;
    }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(1) { --angle: 0deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(2) { --angle: 45deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(3) { --angle: 90deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(4) { --angle: 135deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(5) { --angle: 180deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(6) { --angle: 225deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(7) { --angle: 270deg; }
    .keyword-trends-ai-button .spoke:nth-child(8) { --angle: 315deg; }
    @keyframes spin-container {
        0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
        100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    .keyword-des-gray{
      margin-top: 9px;
    }
    .monopoly-flag-link{
        min-height: 50px;
    }
    .keywords-monopoly-box .modal-body{
        min-height: 543px;
    }
    .tooltip-long-title{
        width: 280px;
    }
    .tips-dark{
        z-index: 9999;
    }
   
   .lhy-hide{
       display: none !important;
   }
</style>

<script>
    //------------------ASIN 价格趋势图-------------------------------
    var priceTrendChart;
    function initpriceTrendChart(chartId) {
        Customer.showChartLoading(priceTrendChart, chartId);
        if (priceTrendChart) priceTrendChart.dispose();
        priceTrendChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('container-trend-price-chart'), 'light');
        // 指定图表的配置项和数据
        var option = {
            title: {
                text: ''
            },
            color: ['#FFAE2D', '#6EC952', '#5FB0FF'],
            tooltip: {
                trigger: 'axis',
                axisPointer: {
                    type: 'cross',
                    label: {
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, .7)',
                       formatter: axisPointerFormatter
                    }
                },
                padding: [15, 15],
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, .7)',
                formatter: function (params) {
                    if(params.length >1){
                        return getTooltipHtml([{
                        key: '产品数量',
                        value: params[0].value,
                        color: params[0].color
                    }, {
                        key: '数量占比',
                        value: params[1].value == 0 ? '0%' : (params[1].value * 100).toFixed(0) + '%',
                        color: params[1].color
                    }]
                    );
                    }else{
                        return getTooltipHtml([{
                        key: params[0].seriesName,
                        value: params[0].value,
                        color: params[0].color
                    }]
                    );
                    }
                    // return getTooltipHtml([{
                    //     key: '产品数量',
                    //     value: params[0].value,
                    //     color: params[0].color
                    // }, {
                    //     key: '数量占比',
                    //     value: params[1].value == 0 ? '0%' : (params[1].value * 100).toFixed(0) + '%',
                    //     color: params[1].color
                    // }]
                    // );
                }
            },
            legend: {
                textStyle: {
                    color: '#505355'
                },
                formatter: function (name) {
                    if (name == '数量') {
                        return '产品数量'
                    } else {
                        return name
                    }
                }
            },
            grid: {
                top: '16%',
                left: '3%',
                right: '3%',
                bottom: '12%',
                containLabel: true
            },
            xAxis: [
                {
                    type: 'category',
                    axisLine: {
                        onZero: true,
                        lineStyle: {
                            color: '#DEE1E7'
                        }
                    },
                    axisLabel: {
                        interval: 0,
                        color: '#656C72',
                    },
                    axisPointer: {
                        type: 'shadow'
                    },
                    data: []
                }
            ],
            yAxis: [
                {
                    type: 'value',
                    name: '数量',
                    nameTextStyle: {
                        color: '#656C72'
                    },
                    axisLine: {
                        lineStyle: {
                            color: '#DEE1E7'
                        }
                    },
                    axisLabel: {
                        color: '#656C72',
                        formatter: '{value}'
                    },
                    splitLine: {
                        lineStyle: {
                            color: '#DEE1E7',
                            type: 'dashed'
                        }
                    }
                },
                {
                    type: 'value',
                    name: '数量占比',
                    nameTextStyle: {
                        color: '#656C72'
                    },
                    axisLine: {
                        lineStyle: {
                            color: '#DEE1E7'
                        }
                    },
                    axisLabel: {
                        color: '#656C72',
                        formatter: function (value) {
                            if (value === 0) {
                                return value + '%';
                            } else {
                                return (value * 100).toFixed(0) + '%';
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    splitLine: {
                        lineStyle: {
                            color: '#DEE1E7',
                            type: 'dashed'
                        }
                    }
                }
            ],
            series: [
                {
                    name: '数量',
                    type: 'bar',
                    barWidth: 40,
                    label: {
                        normal: {
                            position: 'top',
                            show: true,
                            color: '#505355'
                        }
                    },
                    data: []
                },
                {
                    name: '数量占比',
                    type: 'line',
                    smooth: true,
                    yAxisIndex: 1,
                    data: []
                },
            ]
        };

        // 使用刚指定的配置项和数据显示图表。
        priceTrendChart.setOption(option);
        priceTrendChart.resize();
        addChartInstance(priceTrendChart);
    };

                    // }, {

                }

        ratingTrendChart.setOption(option);

        addChartInstance(ratingTrendChart);
    };


    //-------------------Echarts 自适应---------------------------
    var charts = [];
    function addChartInstance(chart) {
        var needAdd = true;
        for (var i = 0; i < charts.length; i++) {
            var dchart = charts[i];
            if (chart.id == dchart.id) {
                needAdd = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (needAdd) charts.push(chart);
    };
    function resizeCharts() {
        for (var i = 0; i < charts.length; i++) {
            var chart = charts[i];
            if (chart && chart['id'] && chart['resize']) {
                try {
                    chart.resize();
                } catch (err) {

                }
            }
        }
    };
    var makertTimeout = null;
    $(document).ready(function () {
        //window 大小重置
        $(window).resize(function () {
            if (makertTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(marketTimeout);
            }
            marketTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
                resizeCharts();
            }, 100);
        });
        //window 大小重置
    });
    var getTooltipHtml = function (data) {
        var _html = '<table class="market-tooltip market-tooltip-small" frame="void">';
        data.forEach(function (item) {
            var div = '<div class="my-tooltip market-tooltip-small">' +
                '<div>' +
                '<div class="my-tooltip-mark1" style="background-color:' + item.color + ' "></div>' +
                '<span>' + item.key + '</span>' +
                '<span class="my-tooltip-value">' + item.value + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</div>';
            _html +=
                '    <tr>' +
                '        <td>' + div + '</td>'
            '    </tr>';
        });
        _html += '</table>';
        return _html;
    };
    //  处理数据
    var asinDatasListAll = {}, asinDatasList = [];
    var dataProcessing = function (paramsObj) {
    var FlagDy=window.location.pathname.indexOf("keyword-miner/dynamic")//关键词动态挖掘
    var FlagSt=window.location.pathname.indexOf("keyword-miner")//静态
    var FlagRs=window.location.pathname.indexOf("keyword-research")//关键词选品
        if(FlagSt != -1 && FlagDy == -1){
                var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month+'&parentModule=KM&dynamic='+false;
            }else if(FlagSt != -1 && FlagDy != -1){//动态
                var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month+'&parentModule=KM&dynamic='+true;
            }
            // else if(FlagRs != -1){
            //     var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month+'&parentModule=KR';

            // }
            else{
                var reqUrl = '/v2/keyword-stat/gkdata?station=' + paramsObj.station + '&keyword=' + paramsObj.keyword+'&month=' + paramsObj.month ;
            }
        
        $.getJSON(reqUrl, function (result) {
            paramsObj.callback(result, paramsObj.popType);
        });
    }
    function callbackItem(result, popType) {
       asinDatasList = result
        asinDatasListAll = {
            price: [],
            review: [],
            rating: [],
            totalLength: asinDatasList.length,
            pricexAxis: [],
            reviewAxis: ['无评分数', '1-50', '50-100', '100-200', '200-300', '300-500', '500以上'],
            ratingxAxis: ['2.0以下', '2.0-3.0', '3.0-3.5', '3.5-4.0', '4.0-4.3', '4.3-4.5', '4.5以上'],
        }
        let priceArray = [];
        $.each(asinDatasListAll.reviewAxis, function (index, item) {
            asinDatasListAll.review.push({
                value: 0,
                data: []
            });
            if (index < asinDatasListAll.ratingxAxis.length) {
                asinDatasListAll.rating.push({
                    value: 0,
                    data: []
                });
            }
        })
        $.each(asinDatasList, function (index, item) {
            //价格区间
            //评分区间 asinRating
            let itemRating = item.asinRating?(item.asinRating * 10).toFixed(0):0, ratingIndex = -1;
            if (itemRating < 20) {
                ratingIndex = 0
            } else if (20 <= itemRating && itemRating < 30) {
                ratingIndex = 1
            } else if (30 <= itemRating && itemRating < 35) {
                ratingIndex = 2
            } else if (35 <= itemRating && itemRating < 40) {
                ratingIndex = 3
            } else if (40 <= itemRating && itemRating < 43) {
                ratingIndex = 4
            } else if (43 <= itemRating && itemRating < 45) {
                ratingIndex = 5
            } else if (45 <= itemRating) {
                ratingIndex = 6
            }
            // //评论数区间  asinReviews
            let itemReviews = item.asinReviews?item.asinReviews:0, reviewsIndex = -1;
            if (itemReviews <= 0) {
                reviewsIndex = 0
            } else if (1 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 50) {
                reviewsIndex = 1
            } else if (50 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 100) {
                reviewsIndex = 2
            } else if (100 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 200) {
                reviewsIndex = 3
            } else if (200 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 300) {
                reviewsIndex = 4
            } else if (300 <= itemReviews && itemReviews < 500) {
                reviewsIndex = 5
            } else if (500 <= itemReviews) {
                reviewsIndex = 6
            }
            item.asinPrice=item.asinPrice?item.asinPrice:0;
            priceArray.push(item.asinPrice);
            if (reviewsIndex >= 0) {
                asinDatasListAll.review[reviewsIndex].data.push(item);
                asinDatasListAll.review[reviewsIndex].value += 1;
            }
            if (ratingIndex >= 0) {
                asinDatasListAll.rating[ratingIndex].data.push(item);
                asinDatasListAll.rating[ratingIndex].value += 1;
            }
        });
        asinDatasListAll.price = Customer.calcPriceChartStepSize(priceArray);
        $.each(asinDatasListAll.price, function (index, item) {
            let len = asinDatasListAll.price.length, keyValue = "";
            if (index < len - 1) {
                keyValue = item.key + '-' + asinDatasListAll.price[index + 1].key
            } else {
                keyValue = item.key + '以上'
            }
            asinDatasListAll.pricexAxis.push(keyValue);
        })
        Customer.closeChartLoading(priceTrendChart)
        Customer.closeChartLoading(reviewTrendChart)
        Customer.closeChartLoading(ratingTrendChart)
        addSeries(popType)
    }
    function addSeries(popType) {
        if (asinDatasList.length == 0) {
            priceTrendChart.hideLoading();
            reviewTrendChart.hideLoading();
            ratingTrendChart.hideLoading();
            $(".prompt-empty").show()
            return;
        }else{
            $(".prompt-empty").hide()
        }
        switch (popType) {
            case 'price':
                priceTrendChart.setOption({
                    legend: {
                        formatter: function (name) {
                            if (name == '数量') {
                                return '产品数量(' + asinDatasListAll.totalLength + ')'
                            } else {
                                return name
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    xAxis: {
                        data: asinDatasListAll.pricexAxis
                    },
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '数量占比',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.price.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: ((item.value / asinDatasListAll.totalLength)).toFixed(2)
                                };
                            })
                        },
                        {
                            name: '数量',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.price.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: item.value,
                                };
                            })
                        },

                    ]
                });
                break;
            case 'reviews':
                reviewTrendChart.setOption({
                    legend: {
                        formatter: function (name) {
                            if (name == '数量') {
                                return '产品数量(' + asinDatasListAll.totalLength + ')'
                            } else {
                                return name
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    xAxis: {
                        data: asinDatasListAll.reviewAxis
                    },
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '数量占比',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.review.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: ((item.value / asinDatasListAll.totalLength)).toFixed(2)
                                };
                            })
                        },
                        {
                            name: '数量',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.review.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: item.value,
                                };
                            })
                        },

                    ]
                });
                break;
            case 'rating':
                ratingTrendChart.setOption({
                    legend: {
                        formatter: function (name) {
                            if (name == '数量') {
                                return '产品数量(' + asinDatasListAll.totalLength + ')'
                            } else {
                                return name
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    xAxis: {
                        data: asinDatasListAll.ratingxAxis
                    },
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '数量占比',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.rating.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: ((item.value / asinDatasListAll.totalLength)).toFixed(2)
                                };
                            })
                        },
                        {
                            name: '数量',
                            data: asinDatasListAll.rating.map(function (item, index) {
                                return {
                                    value: item.value,
                                };
                            })
                        },

                    ]
                });
                break;
        }


    }
    //-------------------Echarts 自适应---------------------------
    //-------------------图表渲染---------------------------
    //-------------------公共常量------------------------
    var showFormat = 'YYYY-MM-DD';
    //-------------------公共常量------------------------

    //-------------------图表渲染---------------------------
    $(document).ready(function () {
        $(".second-nav-js-scrollbar").mCustomScrollbar({axis:"x", theme:"minimal-dark",autoHideScrollbar: true,});
        $.ajax({
            url:"/v2/keyword-stat/gk/month",
            method:"get",
            dataType:"json",
            success:function(data){
                if (data && JSON.stringify(data) != "{}") {
                    data.forEach(function (item, index) {
                        // GK数据后台只保存了近5个月的数据，5个月以前的均没有数据
                        // https://etdxr3a3ez.feishu.cn/record/D69Sr89zveV3slcod3hc4XUFnpf?ccm_open_type=im_card_automation_button
                        if (index > 4) {
                            return;
                        }
                        let li = document.createElement("li")
                        let ul = $(".second-nav")
                        li.className = "second-nav-item"
                        li.dataset.value = item
                        index == 0 ? li.classList.add("second-nav-item-active") : ''
                        li.textContent = item.substr(0, 4) + "/" + item.substr(4)
                        li.onclick = function () {
                            $(this).addClass("second-nav-item-active").siblings().removeClass("second-nav-item-active");
                            $(".nav-item[pop-type='market']").find(".nav-link").click()
                        }
                        ul.append(li)
                    })
                }

            }
        })
        //----------------弹窗 tab 切换----------------------
        $('#modal-nav').on("click", '.nav-item', function () {
            let modalId = 'keywords-monopoly-trends', $modal = $('#' + modalId), popType = $(this).attr('pop-type');;
            //切换modal nav
            if (popType) modalNavSwitch($modal, popType);
        })
        //----------------弹窗 tab 切换----------------------
        //----------------弹窗 显示----------------------
        $("body").on('click','.pop-ele', function () {
            //展示弹窗
            let modalId = 'keywords-monopoly-trends', $modal = $('#' + modalId), that = $(this), popType = that.attr('pop-type'), nrs = that.attr('data-key'),
            website = that.attr('data-station-website');
            //切换modal nav
            let midNode=$(this).closest('tr').find(".show-monopoly-trends")
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.station = midNode.attr("data-countryCode");
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.station =midNode.attr("data-station");
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.currency =midNode.attr("data-currency")||"$";
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.keyword =midNode.attr("data-keyword");
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.gv = (midNode.attr("data-gv") == "true") ? true : false;
            window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.marketKey= midNode.closest('tr').find(".pop-ele").attr('data-key')
            $('[data-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip("hide");
            Customer.showSelfModal(modalId, '95%');
            setTimeout(function () {
                window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.changeActiveItem("market",popType)
                $(".monopoly-flag-link").find(".flag-icon").addClass("flag-icon-" +  window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.station.toLowerCase()).end()
                        .find(".keywords-text").text(window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam.keyword).end();
                        $('[data-tips]').each(tips_popover);
                // 去亚马逊搜索结果页
                $(".link-amazon-listing").attr('href',website+"/s??k="+nrs);
            }, 0);
            return;
        });
        //-------------------弹窗事件---------------------------
        var asinDatasList = {};
        function modalNavSwitch($modal, popType, nowall, nrs) {
            $modal.find('.maket-modal-body>div[id^="container-trend-"]').hide().end().find(".maket-nav-link").removeClass('active').end().find('.maket-nav-link.container-trend-' + popType).addClass('active');
            $modal.find('#container-trend-bsr').show().end().find('.market-modal-chart').hide().end().find('#container-trend-' + popType + '-chart').show();
            //
            //处理时间跨度及图表类型按钮
            if (nowall) {
                loadBsrTrendData(popType, nrs);
            } else {
                addSeries(popType)
            }

            resizeCharts();
        };

        //-------------------数据加载------------------------
        //--------------加载自有 ASIN 趋势数据-------------------------
        function loadBsrTrendData(popType, nrs) {
            let month=$(".second-nav").find(".second-nav-item-active").attr("data-value")
            if(nrs){
                $(".prompt-empty").hide()
            }else{
                $(".prompt-empty").show()
            }
            let condition = $("#form-condition-search");
            // //展示加载中
            if(nrs){
                initpriceTrendChart('container-trend-price-chart');
                initreviewTrendChart('container-trend-reviews-chart');
                initratingTrendChart('container-trend-rating-chart');
                dataProcessing({
                'callback': callbackItem,
                'station': condition.find("input[name=station]").val(),
                'keyword': nrs,
                'popType': popType,
                'month':month,
            });
            }
        };
        window.modalNavSwitch=modalNavSwitch
    });
    //-------------------弹窗事件---------------------------

</script></div>
                </div>
    </div>
</div>
<script>
    var getNewTime = function(onDone){
            $.ajax({
            type:'get',
            url:'/v3/api/ai-analysis/daily-remaining-quota',
            cache:false,
            dataType: "json",
            success:function(res){
                const quota = res.data;
                    var tipText = '当天剩余' + quota + '次';
                    var $tip = $('.ai-expand-product-tip');
                    // bootstrap 初始化后文案存放在 data-original-title，两个都更新
                    $tip.attr('title', tipText).attr('data-original-title', tipText);
                    $tip.find('.ai-expand-product-btn').prop('disabled', quota <= 0);
                    if(onDone) onDone();
            }
        })
    }
    $(function(){
        // 弹窗用 Custombox 打开，不会触发 show.bs.modal，所以在 ready 时直接初始化 tooltip，
        // 并在 hover 时按需拉取最新剩余次数
        var $tip = $('.ai-expand-product-tip');
        $tip.tooltip();
        var hovering = false;
        $tip.on('mouseenter', function(){
            hovering = true;
            getNewTime(function(){ if(hovering){ $tip.tooltip('show'); } });
        }).on('mouseleave', function(){
            hovering = false;
        });
    });
    var goToExpandProductAiAnalysis = function(event) {
        const $el = $(event.currentTarget);
        const postParam = window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend && window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node
            ? window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.node.postParam
            : {};
        const keyword = postParam.keyword;
        const station = postParam.station;
        if (!keyword || !station || $el.prop('disabled')) {
            return;
        }

        $el.prop('disabled', true);
        $el.find('.ai-icon').hide();
        $el.find('.loading-container').show();

        $.ajax({
            type: 'get',
            url: '/v3/api/ai-workflow/expand-product',
            data: {
                "station": station,
                "keyword": keyword
            },
            cache: false,
            dataType: "json",
            success: function(res) {
                if (res && res.data && res.data.taskId) {
                    window.open('/v3/ai-report?id=' + res.data.taskId + '&from=history', '_blank');
                    return;
                }
                if (res && res.message) {
                    alert(res.message);
                }
            },
            complete: function(res) {
                $el.find('.loading-container').hide();
                $el.find('.ai-icon').show();
                $el.prop('disabled', false);
                getNewTime();
            }
        });
    };
</script>

<script id="tpl-research-choose-body" type="text/template">
  {{if customListList.length==0}}
    <tr class="nodata-tr">
      <td class="text-center" colspan="5">
          <div class="item-no-data d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center">主人~ 暂无自定义选品模式！<br/> 建议您点击“保存当前模式”按钮保存您的专属模式<br/> 保存后，下次可点击您的专属模式一键查询</div>
      </td>
    </tr>
    {{else}} 
    {{each(i,vo) customListList}}
    {{if vo.id=="newAdd"}}
    <tr class="new-add-list"  data-trid="{{= vo.id}}">
    {{else}}
    <tr data-trid="{{= vo.id}}" class="category-list-tr">
    {{/if}}
      <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center pl-2">
                  {{= vo.id=='newAdd'? i : (i+1)}}
            </div>
      </td>
      <td class="align-middle text-center text-muted">
            <div class="td d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center pl-1">
                  <span class="${ModuleCustomPreset.marketChoice(vo.content)}"></span>
            </div>
      </td>
        <td class="text-left align-middle">
           <div class="td d-flex align-items-center pl-1">
               <input type="text" value="{{= vo.descibe}}" class="form-control form-control-sm caname-item-choose {{= vo.id == 'newAdd'?'':'is-show-choose'}}" placeholder="输入新模式名称" data-oldtext='{{= vo.descibe}}' ${ (vo.id =='newAdd')?'':'disabled'}>

            </div>
            <div class="td align-items-center justify-content-center choosemode-edite {{= vo.id!='newAdd'?'d-flex':''}}">

                  <a class="link-muted no-decoration lighter ml-2 delete-operation" href="javascrtip:;" data-toggle="tooltip" title="删除"><i class="iconfont icon-delete"></i></a>
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary pt-1 pb-1 pl-2 pr-2 cursor-pointer-item ml-3 quick-accessto" >快速访问</button>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
    {{/each}}
    {{/if}}
