<script>
    window.ppcLang = 'cn'
    function getShowOldPpc() {
        
        var month = $('#form-condition-search select[name="month"]').val();
        // return !isAdminPpc || (!!month && (month < '202508'))
        return (!!month && (month < '202508'))
    }
    function openKeywordStore(a){
        if(a == 'all'){
            let _$keywordList= $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked")
            var form = document.getElementById("form-condition-search");
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            var jsonData = {};
            for (var [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
                jsonData[key] = value;
            }
            let arr = []
            $(".nodeIdPath-radios-box").find("input[type=checkbox]").filter(':checked').each(function(i, el) {
                arr.push($(el).val())
            });
            // console.log(arr,'arr');
            let keywordList=[]
                _$keywordList.each(function () {
                        let keyword = $(this).attr('data-keyword');
                        keyword?keywordList.push(keyword) : null; 
                    });
                setTimeout(() => {
                    $('.keyword-store-href').click()
                }, 100);
                let params = {}
                jsonData.departments = arr;
                // console.log(jsonData);
                allKeywordStoreData('COM',keywordList,'KRS',true,jsonData)
        }else{
            let _$keywordList= $("input[type=checkbox][data-keyword]:checked")
            if(_$keywordList.length<1){
                swal({
                    title: '温馨提示',
                    text:'请至少选择一个关键词',
                    imageUrl:'../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
                    imageSize: '70x70',
                    showConfirmButton: true,
                    });
            }else{
                let keywordList=[]
                _$keywordList.each(function () {
                        let keyword = $(this).attr('data-keyword');
                        keyword?keywordList.push(keyword) : null; 
                    });
                setTimeout(() => {
                    $('.keyword-store-href').click()
                }, 100);
                initKeywordStoreData('COM',keywordList)
            }
        } 
    }
    // 选品模式
    let presetMode = {
        // 类目飙升榜
        "soared": {"order.desc": true, minSearches: 10000, minGrowth: 10},
        // 类目热搜榜, minGrowthTrendMin: 10000
        "large-search": {"order.field": "searches", "order.desc": true},
        // 趋势市场
        "potential": {"order.desc": true, minGrowthTrendMin: 10000, minGrowthRateTrendMin: 10},
        // 高转化产品
        "conversion": {"order.field": "searches", "order.desc": true, minPurchaseRate: 20},
        // 热门市场
        "high-demand": {"order.desc": true, "minSearches": 100000, minGrowth: 10},
    }
    function getWordCount(event,type){
        let $event = $(event.target);
        let minWordCount = $('#form-condition-search input[name=minWordCount]').val() || null;
        let min = type == 'min'? 1 : (minWordCount || 1), max = type == 'min'? 5 : 9;
        let value =parseInt($event.val());
        if(value != null || value != ''){
            value = value < min ? min : value > max ? max : value;
            $event.val(value);
        }
    }
    function fDepartmentListener() {
        $('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]').unbind().click(function () {
            var v = $(this).val(), c = $(this).prop('checked'), _t = $('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]').length, _c = $('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]:checked').length;
//            '--' == v && ($('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]').prop('checked', c));
//            '--' !== v && ($('#form-condition-search [name^=departments][value="--"]').prop('checked', c && (_c > _t - 2)));
            if(v=='any'){
                $('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]').prop('checked', false);
            }else{
              $('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]').each(function () {
                  if($(this).val()=="any"){
                    $(this).prop('checked', false);
                    return
                  }
               });
            }
            $(this).prop('checked', c);
        });
        $('#form-condition-search [name=FormBtnReset]').unbind().click(function () {
            $('#form-condition-search [name^=departments]:checkbox').prop('checked', !1);
            $('#form-condition-search :not(input[type=hidden])').val('');
        });

        var copied_keywords = [], _total = [];
        $('.u-datatable table tbody tr>td:nth-child(3) .span-keywords').each(function () {
            _total.push($.trim($(this).attr('data-keyword')))
        });
        for (var k in _total) {
            _total[k] && _total[k] != '' && _total[k].indexOf('XX') == -1 && copied_keywords.indexOf(_total[k]) === -1 && copied_keywords.push(_total[k]);
        }
        //复制页面关键词
        var clipboard = new ClipboardJS('[data-clipboard-text]', {
            text: function(trigger) {
                return copied_keywords.join('\r\n');
            }
        });
        clipboard.on('success', function(e) {
            var $sms = $(e.trigger);
            $sms.attr('title', '已复制到剪贴板').attr('data-content', '已复制到剪贴板').popover('show');
            setTimeout(function(){$sms.attr('data-content', '')}, 1000);
        });

    }

    // 处理站点月份类目数据
    var GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS = null;
    function handleMakertsTablesDepartments(){
        var jsonStr = $('#data-json-markets-tables-departments').html().trim();
        if(jsonStr){
            GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        }
    }
    handleMakertsTablesDepartments();
    function getTablesDepartmentsByStation(station){
        var tablesDepartmentsObj = null;
        if(GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS){
            for(var i=0;i<GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS.length;i++){
                var obj = GLOBAL_MARKETS_TABLES_DEPARTMENTS[i]
                if(obj){
                    var market = obj['station'];
                    if(market['publicCode'] == station || market['code'] == station || ('' +market['id']) == station){
                        tablesDepartmentsObj = obj;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return tablesDepartmentsObj;
    }

    //加载可查询的月份列表
    function loadDocuments(table,$this){
        var $form = $('#form-condition-search');
        var station = $form.find('input[name="station"]').val();
        var tablesDepartmentsObj = getTablesDepartmentsByStation(station);
        let $monthNameBtns=$form.find("#monthName-btns")
        $monthNameBtns.children().remove()
        let div=document.createElement("div")
        div.className="wrap monthName-btns-nav-js-scrollbar"
        $monthNameBtns.append(div)
        if(tablesDepartmentsObj){
            data = tablesDepartmentsObj['tables'];
            var $select = $form.find('select[name="month"]');
            let $monthNamenav=$form.find(".monthName-btns-nav-js-scrollbar")
            $select.find('option:gt(0)').remove();
            for(var i=data.length-1;i>=0;i--){
                var tableVO = data[i];
                var tb = tableVO['table'];
                var c = '<option value="' + tb + '"> ' + tb.substring(0,4) + '-' + tb.substring(4) + ' </option>';
                $select.find('option:eq(0)').after(c);
                let button= document.createElement("div")
                button.className="btn btn-xs btn-outline-secondary mx-1 mb-2 monthName-button"
                if(table&&table==tb){
                    button.classList.add('active')
                }
                button.textContent=tb.substring(0,4) + '-' + tb.substring(4)    
                button.setAttribute('data-month-id',tb)    
                $monthNamenav.prepend(button)     
            }
            // $(".monthName-btns-nav-js-scrollbar").mCustomScrollbar({axis:"x", theme:"minimal-dark",autoHideScrollbar: true,});
            var $option = $select.find('option[value="'+ table +'"]');
            if(table && $option.length >0) $option.prop('selected','selected');
            else $select.find('option:eq(1)').prop('selected','selected');
        }
        $this = $this?$this:$(".station-button.active")
        let currency_station = $this.attr("data-market-currency"),show_original_title ="";
        if(currency_station=="CDN$"){
            show_original_title =currency_station;
            currency_station = 'C';
        }
        $(".change-currency-unit").text(currency_station).attr("data-original-title",show_original_title);
    };
    // 加载到就执行一次
    loadDocuments('202607');

    // 渲染类目列表
    var GLOBAL_DEPARTMENTS_FIRST_INIT_FLAG = true;
    function initDepartments(station){
        var tablesDepartmentsObj = getTablesDepartmentsByStation(station);
        if(tablesDepartmentsObj){
            var departments = tablesDepartmentsObj['departments'];
            if(departments && departments.length >0 ){
                // 只有第一次判断是否选中，否则都是不选中的状态
                if(!GLOBAL_DEPARTMENTS_FIRST_INIT_FLAG){
                    for(var i=0;i<departments.length;i++){
                        var d = departments[i];
                        d['checked'] = null;
                    }
                }
                $('#search-form-department-label').next().remove();
                $('#search-form-department-label').after($('#template-markets-tables-departments').tmpl({items:departments}));
                fDepartmentListener();
                GLOBAL_DEPARTMENTS_FIRST_INIT_FLAG = false;
                isAllChecked()
               filtersChecked()
            }
        }
    }
    function filtersChecked(){
        $('#form-condition-search').on('click','.nodeIdPath-radios-box input[type=checkbox]',function(){
            let boxCklen = $(".nodeIdPath-radios-box input[type=checkbox]:checked").length, boxAlllen = $(".nodeIdPath-radios-box input[type=checkbox]").length - 1;
            if($(this)[0].id == 'checkbox0') boxCklen = boxCklen - 1;
            if(boxCklen == boxAlllen){
                $('#checkbox0').prop("checked", true)
            }else{
                $('#checkbox0').prop("checked", false)
            }
        })
    }
    // 全选
    function isAllChecked(){
        $('#form-condition-search').on('click','#checkbox0',function(){
            let isChecked = $(this).prop('checked');
            console.log(isChecked);
            $('.nodeIdPath-radios-box input[type=checkbox]').prop("checked", isChecked);
        })
    }
    
    
    // 动态判断评分
    let NoNumTimeout = null;
    function clearNoNum(obj,type,num=2) {
      let reg = num==1?/^(\-)*(\d+)\.(\d).*$/:/^(\-)*(\d+)\.(\d\d).*$/;
      clearTimeout(NoNumTimeout)
      let minMax = type=='minGrowthRateTrendMin'&&(obj.value*100) < (0*100) ? 0 :type=='maxGrowthRateTrendMin'&&(obj.value*100)<(1*100)?1:null;
    //   最小值为10
      obj.value = type=='rating'&&obj.value > 5? 5 : obj.value;
      obj.value = obj.value.replace(/[^\d.]/g, ""); //清除"数字"和"."以外的字符
      obj.value = obj.value.replace(/^\./g, ""); //验证第一个字符是数字而不是
      obj.value = obj.value.replace(/\.{2,}/g, "."); //只保留第一个. 清除多余的
      obj.value = obj.value.replace(".", "$#$").replace(/\./g, "").replace("$#$", ".");
      obj.value = obj.value.replace(reg, '$1$2.$3'); //只能输入1或2个小数
      if(minMax){
        NoNumTimeout = setTimeout(()=>{
            obj.value = (type=='maxGrowthRateTrendMin'||type=='minGrowthRateTrendMin')&&minMax?minMax:obj.value
        },2000)
      }
    }
    function blurclearNoNum(obj,type){
        clearTimeout(NoNumTimeout);
        if (obj.value != '') {
            let minMax = type == 'minGrowthRateTrendMin' && (obj.value * 100) < (0 * 100) ? 0 :
                type == 'maxGrowthRateTrendMin' && (obj.value * 100) < (1 * 100) ? 1 : null;
            obj.value = (type == 'maxGrowthRateTrendMin' || type == 'minGrowthRateTrendMin') && minMax ? minMax : obj.value
        }
    }
    jQuery(function($) {
        let loaclRange = localStorage.getItem("products-top-ten") ? localStorage.getItem("products-top-ten") : 2;
         
        let itemImageRange = $('input[name=itemImageRange]').val()?$('input[name=itemImageRange]').val():loaclRange;
        $('input[name=itemImageRange]').val(itemImageRange);
        
        initDepartments($('#form-condition-search').find('input[name="station"]').val());
           //月份button点击
        $('#monthName-btns').on('click','.monthName-button', function(){
            $('#form-condition-search select[name=month]').val($(this).attr('data-month-id'));
            $(this).parent().find('.monthName-button').removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active')
        });
        $('#form-condition-search button[data-market]').click(function () {
            var m = $(this).attr('data-market'), _v = $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]').val();
            $('#form-condition-search input[name=station]').val(m);
            $('#form-condition-search button[data-market]').removeClass('active');
            $(this).addClass('active');

            initDepartments(m);
        });

        //排序
        $('#table-condition-search .order-field').bind('click', function(){
            var $form = $('#form-condition-search');
            var desc = true;
            var orderField = $(this).attr('order-field');
            var $orderSpan = $(this).find('.order-span');
            if($orderSpan.hasClass('fa-angle-down') && $orderSpan.hasClass('order-span-active')) desc = false;
            $form.find('input[name="order.field"]').val(orderField);
            $form.find('input[name="order.desc"]').val(desc);
            $form.submit();
        });
        //排序

        //选品模式
        $('.a-model').bind('click', function(){
            var station = $('#form-condition-search').find('input[name="station"]').val();
            if(!station) station = 'US';
            var monthName = $('#form-condition-search').find('select[name="month"]').val();
            var itemImageRange = $('input[name=itemImageRange]').val();
            var url = '/v2/keyword-research?station=' + station + '&itemImageRange='+itemImageRange;
            if(monthName){
                url = url + '&month='+ monthName
            }
            let mode = $(this).attr("data-preset-mode");
            url += '&' + parseUrlParam(presetMode[mode]) + '&presetMode=' + mode;
            $(".nodeIdPath-radios-box").find("input[type=checkbox]").filter(':checked').each(function(i, el) {
                url = url + '&' + $(el).attr("name") + '='+ $(el).val()
            });
            window.location.href = url;
        });
        //选品模式

        //点击关闭弹窗
        $('.u-popup').on('click','.mask',function(){
            $(this).parent().find('.close').click();
        });
        //点击关闭弹窗

        //切换站点的时候也加载一次
        $('.station-button').bind('click', function(){
            loadDocuments('202607',$(this));
        });
        //加载可查询的月份列表

        //点击关闭弹窗
        $('.mask').bind('click',function(){
            $(this).parent().find('.close').click();
        });

        // 初始化剪切板事件
        var initclipboardEvent = function(){
            var clipboard = new ClipboardJS('[data-clipboard]', {
                text: function(trigger) {
                    var txt = $(trigger).attr('data-clipboard');
                    return  txt;
                }
            });
            clipboard.on('success', function(e) {
                var $sms = $(e.trigger);
                var tips = $sms.attr('data-original-title');
                $sms.attr('data-original-title', '已经复制到粘贴板！');
                $sms.tooltip('show');
                setTimeout(function(){
                    $sms.attr('data-original-title', tips);
                }, 1000);
            });
        };
        initclipboardEvent();

        window.ModuleKeywordsTrend.on();
        window.ModuleKeywordsMonopolyTrend.init('CN');
        // 保存查询模式 MR=选市场
        window.ModuleCustomPreset.init('CN', 'KR');
    });

    /**
     * 修改产品信息
     * @param item
     */
    function editproduct($span,keyword,station){

        var product =  $($span).prev().html();
        $('#edit-keyword').val(keyword);
        $('#edit-product-value').val(product.replace(/,/g,''));

        $('#edit-form button').click(function () {
            $product = $('#edit-product-value').val();
            if(!$("#edit-product-value").val()){
                //未输入结果数
                $("#edit-product-value").focus().popover({trigger:'focus'});
                $("#edit-product-value").popover('show');
                return;
            }
            if(!$product || !$product.match(/^[0-9]*[1-9][0-9]*$/)){
                $('#edit-product-value').attr('data-content','请输入正确的结果数');
                $('#edit-product-value').focus().popover('show');
                return;
            }
            $('#edit-form button').prop('disabled',true);
            $('#edit-form input').prop('readonly',true);
            $('#reset-save').html('<i class="fa fa-spin fa-circle-notch mr-1"></i>保存中...')

            var param = {'keywords': $('#edit-keyword').val(),
                'products': $product};
            $.ajax({
                type: "post",
                url: "/v2/update/" + station,
                data: JSON.stringify(param),
                cache: false,
                async: false,
                dataType: "json",
                contentType:'application/json',
                success: function (data) {
                    $('#edit-form button').prop('disabled',false);
                    $('#edit-form input').prop('readonly',false);
                    $('#reset-save').html('保存');
                    if(data.data>0){
                        $($span).prev().html(numFormat($product));
                    }
                    swal({
                        title: '操作结果',
                        text: (data.data>0)? '校正成功':'校正失败',
                        type: 'info',
                        confirmButtonText: "<span>确定</span>"
                    });
                    return;
                }
            });
        })

    }
    function numFormat(num) {
        var c = (num.toString().indexOf('.') !== -1) ? num.toLocaleString() : num.toString().replace(
            /(\d)(?=(?:\d{3})+$)/g, '$1,');
        return c;
    }


    function showPop(){
        swal({
            title: '温馨提示',
            html: `<div>数据导出中，需要1-5分钟...</div><div>请稍后在右上角“我的导出”中下载</div>`,
            imageUrl: '../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
            imageSize: '70x70',
            showCancelButton: true,
            showConfirmButton: true,
            confirmButtonText:'前往查看',
            cancelButtonText: "等会儿看",
            language_name: 'cn',
        }).then( (isConfirm) => {
            console.log(isConfirm)
            if(isConfirm.value){
                window.open('/v2/export-log', 'blank')
            }
        });
    }

   $('#async-list-research-export').click(function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const $btn = $(this); 
        if($btn.attr('export_remain_num') == 0) return
        const url = $btn.data('action');
        let $form = $('#form-condition-search');
        // 发送请求
        $.ajax({
            type: 'GET',
            url: url,
            data: $form.serialize()+'&mainImage='+(localStorage.getItem('export-picture')=='true')+'&module='+ $btn.data('module')+ (getShowOldPpc() ? '' : '&keywordBidMatchType='+$('[name=ppcBidMatchType]').val()),
            contentType: false, 
            processData: false, 
            dataType: 'json',  
            beforeSend: function() {
            $btn.prop('disabled', true)
            },
            complete: function() {
            $btn.prop('disabled', false)
            },
            success: function(data) {
            if (data.code === 'OK') {
                reduceTheNumberOfExport($btn)
                showPop();
            } else {
                console.error('导出失败:', data.message);
                alert('导出失败: ' + (data.message || '未知错误'));
            }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
            console.error('请求失败:', error);
            alert('网络错误，请刷新重试');
            }
        });
    });



    // 排序规则
     $("body").on("click","button[name=orderBtn]",function () {
        var orderField = $('select[name=marketQuota]').find('option:selected').val();
        var orderFlag = $('select[name=quotaOrder]').find('option:selected').val();
        if (orderField === '') {
            return;
        }
        // 为true: 降序，为false: 升序
        var orderDesc = parseInt(orderFlag) === 1;
        $('input[name="order.field"]').val(orderField);
        $('input[name="order.desc"]').val(orderDesc);
        var $form = $('#form-condition-search');
        $form.submit();
    });

    // 表单提交拦截
    let excludeKeyReg = /^(station|order\.field|order\.desc|supplement|usestatic|limitUserStatic|adminDes|presetMode|month|departments\[\d+\])$/
    function formOnSubmit() {
        // 检测参数是否完全符合选品模式，不符合时清空模式
        let $presetMode = $('input[name="presetMode"]');
        if ($presetMode.val() && presetModeIsChange("form-condition-search", excludeKeyReg, presetMode[$presetMode.val()])) {
            $presetMode.val("");
        }
        const keywordBidMatchTypeValue = getShowOldPpc() ? '' : $('select[name="ppcBidMatchType"]').val() || 'exact'
        $('input[name="keywordBidMatchType"]').val(keywordBidMatchTypeValue)
        return true;
    }
    $('.export-keyword-btns').on('click', function () {
        const _btn = $(this)
        if(false){
            return
        }
        let checkList = getSelectedKeywords();
        if (checkList.length < 1 || checkList.length > 50) {
            swal({
                title: '温馨提示',
                text: '请选择需要导出的关键词，最少1个，最多可选50个',
                imageUrl: '../../../assets/images/bounced-warning.png',
                imageSize: '70x70',
                showConfirmButton: true,
                confirmButtonText:'确定',
                language_name: 'cn',
            });
        } else {
            if(_btn.attr('export_remain_num') == 0) return
            const isAdmin = false
            const showOldPpc = getShowOldPpc()
            if(isAdmin){
                 const params = { station:"US", keywords: checkList, parentModule: 'EKR' }
                if (!showOldPpc) {
                    params.keywordBidMatchType = $('[name=ppcBidMatchType]').val()
                }

                 $.ajax({
                    type : "POST",
                    contentType: "application/json;charset=UTF-8",
                    url :"/v2/keyword-history/async-export",
                    data :JSON.stringify(params),
                    cache: false,
                    headers: {
                        'Accept': 'application/json'
                    },
                    success:function(res){
                    reduceTheNumberOfExport(_btn)
                    showPop()
                    },
                    fail: function(err) {
                        console.log(err)
                    }
                })
            }else{
                let $this=$(this)
                $this.find(".fa-spinner").show()
                const params = { station:"US", keywords: checkList }
                if (!showOldPpc) {
                    params.keywordBidMatchType = $('[name=ppcBidMatchType]').val()
                }

                const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onload = function (e) {
                    const blob = new Blob([xhr.response], { type: "application/octet-stream" }); 
                    const contentDisposition = xhr.getResponseHeader("Content-Disposition");
                    let link = document.createElement("a");
                    let fileName = "unknow.xxx";
                    if (contentDisposition) {
                        fileName =contentDisposition.split(";")[1].split("filename=")[1];
                    }
                    link.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    link.download = fileName;
                    link.click();
                    link.remove();
                    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
                    $this.find(".fa-spinner").hide()
                }
                xhr.open('POST', '/v2/keyword/keywords-batch-export');
                xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type','application/json');
                xhr.responseType = "blob"
                try {
                    xhr.send(JSON.stringify(params) );
                } catch (error) {
                    $this.find(".fa-spinner").hide()
                }
            }
        }    
    })
